appearance_body_floor.en: a whole number of pixels from {min} up; an empty box takes the size the page is drawn at
appearance_body_floor.zh: {min} 起的整数像素；留空即采用页面本来的字号

appearance_local_denied.en: the browser did not hand over the list; write the stack instead
appearance_local_denied.zh: 浏览器没有交出字体列表，请改为手写字体栈

appearance_local_for.en: {face}, from the faces this computer has
appearance_local_for.zh: {face}：从这台电脑装好的字体里选

appearance_local_none.en: this browser does not offer its installed faces; write the stack instead
appearance_local_none.zh: 这个浏览器不提供已装字体列表，请改为手写字体栈

appearance_sample.en: The city keeps 1 ledger, and reads both 中文 and English from it.
appearance_sample.zh: 这座城只有 1 本 ledger，中文与 English 都从那里读出来。

appearance_stack_help.en: family names separated by commas; the first one that is installed is used
appearance_stack_help.zh: 用逗号分隔的字体名，取其中第一个装了的

appearance_stack_refused.en: only letters, digits, spaces, commas and quotes belong in a stack
appearance_stack_refused.zh: 字体栈里只能有字母、数字、空格、逗号和引号

ask_late.en: the page keeps asking; if no answer ever comes back, reconnect from the notice
ask_late.zh: 页面会继续追问；若始终等不到回答，就从那条通知重连一次

bin_nothing.en: the recycle bin is empty: a file a run discards lands here, with the way to bring it back
bin_nothing.zh: 回收站是空的：run 丢掉的文件会落在这里，并写明怎样找回

bld_pursuit_finished.en: finished: nothing is ready and nobody is working
bld_pursuit_finished.zh: 已完成：没有就绪的活，也没有 run 在做

bld_pursuit_waiting.zh: 在等 {runs} 个还没结束的 run

bld_room_name.en: name a room to talk in
bld_room_name.zh: 给要说话的房间起个名字

city_drawing.en: the city, one block per building

city_layer_note.en: what every run in this city starts with unless its building or session says otherwise; written to CONFIG.toml
city_layer_note.zh: 城里每个 run 开始时的默认，楼或会话另有设定时以它们为准；写进 CONFIG.toml

city_keep_warm.zh: 保持 prompt 缓存不过期

city_tower_line.zh: {runs} 次 run，{active} 在跑 · 完成 {percent}%

commits_all.en: that is every commit this building made
commits_all.zh: 这栋楼的提交都在这里了

commits_empty.en: no commits yet: a run's work lands here when it commits in this building
commits_empty.zh: 还没有提交：派活在这栋楼里提交后，会出现在这里

commits_more.en: older commits arrive as you scroll
commits_more.zh: 向下滚动，更早的提交随之载入

cost_empty.en: no run has spent anything yet
cost_empty.zh: 还没有哪次派活花掉钱

cost_unpriced.en: {calls} model calls came back with no price; they used {tokens} tokens
cost_unpriced.zh: {calls} 次模型调用没有报价，共用了 {tokens} 个 token

context_second_note.en: where in the window the line about a handoff is said
context_second_note.zh: 窗口用到几成时，提醒该写交接了

context_second_range.en: a whole percent of the window from {min} to {max}; an empty box is the city's default
context_second_range.zh: 窗口的整数百分比，{min} 到 {max}；留空即城的默认值

desktop_missing.en: This building has no desktop allowlist yet, so no run in it may touch a window. Write the windows it may touch in the box above and save: that creates {path}.
desktop_missing.zh: 这栋楼还没有桌面白名单，所以楼里的 run 碰不了任何窗口。在上面的框里写下它能碰的窗口，保存后就会建出 {path}。

dir_earlier_runs.en: earlier runs, not on this page · {n}

dir_governance_what.en: the rules and the configuration this building runs under
dir_governance_what.zh: 这栋楼依照的规则与配置

dir_room_empty.en: no run has worked in this room yet
dir_room_empty.zh: 还没有 run 在这个房间里干过活

effort_note_high.en: deeper reasoning at a higher price per answer, which is what most planning wants.
effort_note_high.zh: 推理更深、单次回答更贵，多数规划工作要的就是这一档。

effort_note_low.en: a short look before answering, for work whose steps are already known.
effort_note_low.zh: 答前略作检视，适合步骤已经定下来的活。

effort_note_max.en: the most this provider will spend on one answer: slowest, and dearest.
effort_note_max.zh: 这家供应方肯为一次回答花的上限：最慢，也最贵。

effort_note_medium.en: the balance between what an answer costs and how far it reasons.
effort_note_medium.zh: 在回答的开销与推理的深度之间取平衡。

effort_note_none.en: thinking off: the model answers from the prompt without reasoning first.
effort_note_none.zh: 关掉思考：模型不先推理，直接依提示作答。

effort_note_unstated.en: nobody has chosen: the field is left out and this provider decides.
effort_note_unstated.zh: 还没有人选过：请求不写这个字段，由这家供应方自己决定。

effort_note_xhigh.en: longer reasoning, for work that has to be right the first time.
effort_note_xhigh.zh: 更长的推理，留给一次就要做对的活。

enrol_city_said_nothing.en: the city did not say why

enrol_unreachable.en: this browser could not reach the city
enrol_unreachable.zh: 这个浏览器联系不上这座城

refrain_save_nothing.en: nothing changed since the city's version
refrain_save_nothing.zh: 与城里的版本相比没有改动

refrain_save_wait.en: the save in flight has no receipt yet
refrain_save_wait.zh: 上一次保存还没有回执

refrain_receipt_pending_why.en: the link dropped after the save left; it is sent again when the link is back
refrain_receipt_pending_why.zh: 保存发出后链路断了；链路恢复时会再发一次核对

refrain_gathering.en: read only until the whole text arrives: {through} of {total}

refrain_too_large.en: {total} is more than RefRain edits; the first {through} is shown read only
refrain_too_large.zh: {total} 超过 RefRain 能编辑的大小；只读显示前 {through}

refrain_recorded.en: version {version} is not the file's current one; read only
refrain_recorded.zh: 版本 {version} 不是这份文件此刻的版本；只读

refrain_lost.en: the city can no longer read version {version}

refrain_unreadable.en: the city cannot read this file: {reason}

refrain_conflict.en: the file is version {version} in the city now; your draft is kept
refrain_conflict.zh: 城里的这份文件已经是版本 {version}；草稿留着

refrain_conflict_unknown.en: the city refused the save because the file moved; your draft is kept
refrain_conflict_unknown.zh: 文件已经变了，城拒绝了这次保存；草稿留着

refrain_discard_detail.en: the editor shows the city's version and the unsaved changes are gone
refrain_discard_detail.zh: 编辑器改显城里的版本，未保存的改动不再保留

refrain_draft_lost.en: a draft kept for version {version} cannot be restored: the city can no longer read that version
refrain_draft_lost.zh: 为版本 {version} 留的草稿恢复不了：城已读不到那一版

refrain_preview_draft.en: the preview is version {version}; unsaved changes are not in it
refrain_preview_draft.zh: 预览的是版本 {version}；未保存的改动不在其中

refrain_preview_unsupported.en: this version does not read as Markdown ({encoding})
refrain_preview_unsupported.zh: 这一版不按 Markdown 读（{encoding}）

refrain_preview_empty.en: this version has nothing to preview
refrain_preview_empty.zh: 这一版没有可预览的内容

refrain_versions_one.en: the city knows one version of this file
refrain_versions_one.zh: 城只知道这份文件的一个版本

refrain_version_on_disk.en: on disk now, written outside the page
refrain_version_on_disk.zh: 盘上此刻的一版，页面之外写下

refrain_versions_asking.en: asking the city for this file's versions…
refrain_versions_asking.zh: 正在问城这份文件的各版…

refrain_version_lost.en: The city can no longer read one of these versions.

refrain_compared_source.en: the source text, line by line

refrain_export_asking.en: the city is writing the export

refrain_export_refused.en: The city could not export this version.

refrain_cm_replaced_line.zh: 替换了第 $ 行的匹配

format_html_settings.en: scripts off · outside resources not read · links do not open
format_html_settings.zh: 脚本关闭 · 不读外部资源 · 链接不打开

format_pdf_settings.en: Adobe CMaps · fonts the file leaves out drawn with the device's own faces
format_pdf_settings.zh: Adobe CMap · 文件没带的字体用设备自带的字体画

format_docx_settings.en: approximate layout · tracked changes shown as their result · comments not shown
format_docx_settings.zh: 近似版式 · 修订按接受后的结果显示 · 不显示批注

format_locked.en: This PDF is protected by a password. The page does not open it; the file itself is unchanged.
format_locked.zh: 这份 PDF 有密码保护，页面不打开它；文件本身不动。

format_broken.en: This {format} could not be read ({reason}). The file itself is unchanged.
format_broken.zh: 读不出这份 {format}（{reason}）。文件本身不动。

format_zip_shape.en: it is not a ZIP archive this page reads
format_zip_shape.zh: 它不是本页读得懂的 ZIP 包

format_no_text.en: pages with no text layer are not compared and not read (a scan or drawn letters; no OCR is done): {pages}
format_no_text.zh: 没有文字层的页不比较也不朗读（扫描件或画出的字；不做 OCR）：{pages}

format_docx_revisions.en: {n} tracked changes, shown as their result

format_compare_pdf.en: compared: the text of each page in reading order; layout, pictures and fonts are not compared
format_compare_pdf.zh: 比较的是每页按阅读顺序的文字；版式、图片与字体不比较

format_compare_docx.en: compared: the body's paragraphs as their tracked changes leave them; headers, footers, comments and objects are not compared
format_compare_docx.zh: 比较的是正文段落按修订接受后的文字；页眉、页脚、批注与对象不比较

format_compare_broken.en: One of the two versions could not be read, so they are not compared.
format_compare_broken.zh: 两版里有一版读不出，所以不比较。

format_compare_same.en: the two versions read the same text

format_too_large.en: This {format} is {kib}, more than the {most} the page draws. The file itself is unchanged.
format_too_large.zh: 这份 {format} 有 {kib}，超过页面画的 {most}。文件本身不动。

format_lost.en: The city no longer holds this version, so it is not drawn. The file itself is unchanged.
format_lost.zh: 城不再存有这一版，所以不画。文件本身不动。

compared_none.en: The two versions read the same text.

proposal_stale.en: This card was made on {was}, and the document is now {now}. It can only be rejected; the run can offer it again on what the document says now.
proposal_stale.zh: 这张卡基于 {was}，文稿现在是 {now}。它只能被拒绝；run 可以在文稿现在的文字上重新提出。

proposal_no_version.en: no version (the file is missing or unreadable)
proposal_no_version.zh: 没有版本（文件缺失或读不了）

proposal_stale_why.en: this card was made on an older version of the document
proposal_stale_why.zh: 这张卡基于文稿的旧版本

proposal_busy_why.en: the decision on this card is on its way
proposal_busy_why.zh: 这张卡的决定已经发出

proposal_pending.en: The link dropped before the city answered. The same decision goes again when the link is back, and the city answers it once.
proposal_pending.zh: 城回答之前链路断了。链路恢复后同一个决定再发一次，城只答一次。

proposal_nothing_taken.en: nothing is taken, which is a rejection
proposal_nothing_taken.zh: 一句都没取，这等于拒绝

proposal_amend.en: the inserted sentence, as it will land
proposal_amend.zh: 插入的这一句，落下时的文字

proposal_show_why.en: the editor holds another version of the document
proposal_show_why.zh: 编辑器里是文稿的另一版

gallery_tip_tall.en: This hint is deliberately long. It opens above the control, and where the window has no room above it the engine drops it below instead; a short hint halfway down a page never asks for that, so the fallback goes unseen. Read where this box lands: above the button means there was room, below it means the flip happened, and a box hanging off the top of the window means neither branch took.
gallery_tip_tall.zh: 这条提示故意写得很长。它开在控件上方；窗口上方腾不出位置时，引擎改把它放到下方。页面中段的一条短提示从不提出这个要求，那条回退分支也就无人看见。看这个框落在哪里：在按钮上方说明位置够用，在下方说明翻转发生了，而挂在窗口上缘之外说明两条分支都没有生效。

git_clean.en: nothing has changed since the last checkpoint
git_clean.zh: 上一个检查点之后没有改动

git_since_checkpoint.zh: 上一个检查点之后的改动

git_unavailable.en: this city has no repository to read
git_unavailable.zh: 这座城没有可读的仓库

mailbox_deciding_none.en: nothing waits for you to decide

mailbox_search.en: search sessions by room or task

mailbox_search_reach.en: Searches every session asked of the rooms this page has seen; a room with no run on this page was not asked.
mailbox_search_reach.zh: 在本页见过的房间问回来的全部会话里找；本页没见过 run 的房间没有问过，不在其中。

mailbox_search_none.zh: 问回来的会话里没有匹配的。

mailbox_earlier.en: {n} earlier sessions are not listed here
mailbox_earlier.zh: 更早的 {n} 段会话不在此处

mailbox_fork_unheld.en: the last run of this session is older than what this page holds
mailbox_fork_unheld.zh: 这段会话的最后一个 run 早于本页持有的范围

mailbox_ask_title.en: a door waits for your own hand
mailbox_ask_title.zh: 一个门在等你亲自动手

mailbox_new.en: something new, nothing waiting for you
mailbox_new.zh: 有新消息，没有等你的事

keys_reserved.en: the browser takes this key before the page sees it
keys_reserved.zh: 此键被浏览器截走，页面收不到

legend_figure.en: a figure at the door is a run still moving
legend_figure.zh: 门口的人影是还在动的 run

legend_flag.en: a flag on the roof is a standing goal
legend_flag.zh: 屋顶的旗子是一条长期目标

legend_lamp.en: a lamp by the door is something stuck
legend_lamp.zh: 门边的灯是有东西卡住了

legend_plinth.en: the plinth is how much of the plan is done
legend_plinth.zh: 基座是计划完成了多少

inbox_count.en: {n} signals waiting for a run here
inbox_count.zh: {n} 条信号在等这里的 run 读

legend_window.en: a lit window is a run

link_send_action.en: send a command to the city

link_send_when_connected.en: wait until the page says it is connected, then do it again
link_send_when_connected.zh: 等页面显示已连接，再做一次

log_window.en: the last lines this page was sent; a log is not history
log_window.zh: 这页收到的最后几行；日志不是历史

machine_core_held.zh: 正常档，按 config.toml 的 [core] priority

machine_core_lowered.en: normal, lowered after keeping a core busy
machine_core_lowered.zh: 正常档，占满一个核之后被降回

machine_core_refused.en: normal, the platform refused the raise
machine_core_refused.zh: 正常档，平台拒绝了升档

machine_enables_bash.en: just, which runs every recipe of this repository in bash
machine_enables_bash.zh: just，这个仓库的每一个配方都在 bash 里跑

machine_enables_bun.en: just build-web and the client's checks, which the artifact gates judge
machine_enables_bun.zh: just build-web 与客户端自己的检查，产物门要看它们的结果

machine_enables_cargo_deny.en: just deny, the supply-chain read just gates ends with; CI runs it on every push
machine_enables_cargo_deny.zh: just deny，just gates 最后那一步供应链检查；CI 每次推送都会跑

machine_enables_cargo_fuzz.en: just fuzz <target>, which needs a nightly toolchain as well
machine_enables_cargo_fuzz.zh: just fuzz <target>，另外还需要一个 nightly 工具链

machine_enables_cargo_mutants.en: just mutants, which asks whether the tests notice a change in a module held to a mutation score
machine_enables_cargo_mutants.zh: just mutants，检验受变异分数约束的模块被改动后测试能否发现

machine_enables_cargo_nextest.en: just test, the test runner every check here calls
machine_enables_cargo_nextest.zh: just test，这里每道检查都调用的测试运行器

machine_enables_chromedriver.en: the browser tool against Chrome, Brave, Chromium or Vivaldi
machine_enables_chromedriver.zh: 对 Chrome、Brave、Chromium 或 Vivaldi 使用浏览器工具

machine_enables_chromium.en: the browser tool through chromedriver or msedgedriver, whose major version must match the browser found here
machine_enables_chromium.zh: 经 chromedriver 或 msedgedriver 使用浏览器工具；驱动的主版本号须与这里找到的浏览器一致

machine_enables_clippy.en: cargo clippy -D warnings, where this workspace's lints take effect
machine_enables_clippy.zh: cargo clippy -D warnings，本工作区的 lint 在这里生效

machine_enables_elan.en: the Lean toolchain manager that just models and just adversary run through
machine_enables_elan.zh: Lean 工具链管理器，just models 与 just adversary 经它运行

machine_enables_ffmpeg.en: an mp4 from the desktop connector's recorder; without it, a frame sequence
machine_enables_ffmpeg.zh: 让桌面连接器的录制器产出 mp4；没有它，只产出逐帧图片

machine_enables_gecko.zh: 浏览器工具，城与浏览器之间不隔驱动；Firefox、Zen、LibreWolf、Waterfox、Floorp 与 Firefox Developer 都算，Tor Browser 也算，但要 User 亲手确认

machine_enables_git.en: version control for this repository, and restoring a discarded file from its checkpoint
machine_enables_git.zh: 本仓库的版本控制，也用来从检查点找回丢弃的文件

machine_enables_just.en: just check, the check every change here closes on
machine_enables_just.zh: just check，这里每一处改动都以它收尾

machine_enables_kani.en: just proof, proving a property against real MIR, on Linux only
machine_enables_kani.zh: just proof，对真实的 MIR 证明性质，只在 Linux 上可用

machine_enables_msedgedriver.en: the browser tool against Edge, which every Windows machine already has
machine_enables_msedgedriver.zh: 对 Edge 使用浏览器工具，每台 Windows 机器都自带 Edge

machine_enables_python_wasi.en: the exec tool's python arm, which runs in the sandbox with no socket
machine_enables_python_wasi.zh: exec 工具的 python 一支，在沙箱里运行，没有套接字

machine_enables_rustfmt.en: cargo fmt --check, the first step of just check
machine_enables_rustfmt.zh: cargo fmt --check，just check 的第一步

machine_enables_rustup.en: cargo and the Rust toolchain rust-toolchain.toml pins, fetched on first use
machine_enables_rustup.zh: cargo 与 rust-toolchain.toml 钉住的 Rust 工具链，第一次用到时下载

machine_enables_sandbox_engine.en: the exec tool's program and python arms, fuel-metered and with no socket
machine_enables_sandbox_engine.zh: exec 工具的 program 与 python 两支：按燃料计量，没有套接字

machine_enables_shell.en: the exec tool's shell arm, where a building's CONFIG.toml asks for it
machine_enables_shell.zh: exec 工具的 shell 一支，用于 CONFIG.toml 要求它的楼

machine_enables_webkit.en: the browser tool against Safari, experimentally: BiDi support is partial and safaridriver --enable has to be run once
machine_enables_webkit.zh: 对 Safari 使用浏览器工具，尚属试验：BiDi 支持不全，且须先运行一次 safaridriver --enable

machine_enables_lean.en: just models, the Lean design models, at the version lean-toolchain pins
machine_enables_lean.zh: just models 跑的 Lean 设计模型，版本是 lean-toolchain 钉住的那个

machine_enables_python.en: Python for the probes and data transforms, installed and managed by uv
machine_enables_python.zh: 探针与数据转换用的 Python，由 uv 安装和管理

machine_enables_render_browser.en: cargo xtask render, which measures the built client in a headless Chromium browser
machine_enables_render_browser.zh: cargo xtask render，用无头 Chromium 浏览器量构建好的客户端

machine_enables_rust.en: the compiler, at the version rust-toolchain.toml pins, which rustup fetches on first use
machine_enables_rust.zh: 编译器，版本是 rust-toolchain.toml 钉住的那个，rustup 第一次用到时下载

machine_source_powershell.en: the official elan-init.ps1 script, run by this city without a prompt
machine_source_powershell.zh: elan 官方的 elan-init.ps1 脚本，由城直接运行，不需要你粘贴

machine_pack_rust_tools_note.en: the cargo subcommands this repository's recipes and workflows call
machine_pack_rust_tools_note.zh: 本仓库的 recipe 与工作流调用的那些 cargo 子命令

machine_pack_install_note.en: one at a time, each compiled from crates.io, each with its own log
machine_pack_install_note.zh: 逐项安装，每一项从 crates.io 编译，各有一份日志

machine_unread_with_toolchain.zh: 随 Rust 工具链发布

machine_unread_many_brands.en: each browser has its own releases

machine_unread_no_source.en: no official release feed to read
machine_unread_no_source.zh: 没有可读的官方发布源

machine_unread_unknown_item.en: this city does not know the item

machine_enables_uv.en: the Python this repository's probes and maintenance scripts run on
machine_enables_uv.zh: 本仓库探针与维护脚本所用的 Python

machine_enables_zig.en: the Zig leaf crates/desktop/ffi builds on Windows, at the version crates/desktop/ffi/zig-version pins
machine_enables_zig.zh: Windows 上编译 crates/desktop/ffi 的 Zig 叶子，版本是 crates/desktop/ffi/zig-version 钉住的那个
