machine_install_by_hand.zh: {site} 的官方安装脚本；页面不替你运行下载来的脚本，请粘贴到终端里运行

machine_install_admin.en: this needs administrator rights, which this page never asks for, so run it in a terminal
machine_install_admin.zh: 这一条要管理员权限，页面从不申请，请在终端里运行

machine_install_press.en: {source}; this changes the computer, so it runs only when you press install
machine_install_press.zh: {source}；这会改动这台电脑，所以只在你按下「安装」时运行

machine_install_all_note.en: one at a time, in the order below, each after the tools it needs
machine_install_all_note.zh: 按下面的顺序逐项安装，先装后面几项要用到的工具

machine_no_recipe.zh: 这个平台没有安装配方

mcp_command_help.en: the program and its arguments, as one line

mcp_env_help.en: what the program is started with; a value may be a `secret:realm/name` reference
mcp_env_help.zh: 启动这个程序时带上的变量；值可以写成 `secret:realm/name` 引用

mcp_gap_scope_city.en: the wire writes every server into the building layer
mcp_gap_scope_city.zh: wire 把每台服务器都写进楼这一层

mcp_gap_scope_machine.en: a server kept out of the repository has nowhere to go on the wire
mcp_gap_scope_machine.zh: 不写进仓库的服务器在 wire 上没有去处

mcp_header_help.en: sent with every request; a value may be a `secret:realm/name` reference
mcp_header_help.zh: 每次请求都会带上；值可以写成 `secret:realm/name` 引用

mcp_json_placeholder.en: the mcpServers block from Claude Code or Cursor
mcp_json_placeholder.zh: Claude Code 或 Cursor 的 mcpServers 段

mcp_json_unreadable.en: this is not a readable mcpServers block
mcp_json_unreadable.zh: 这不是一段能读的 mcpServers

mcp_key_first.en: store the key first; the header carries its reference
mcp_key_first.zh: 先把密钥入库，请求头带的是它的引用

mcp_label_help.en: lowercase letters, digits and dashes; it prefixes every tool this server offers
mcp_label_help.zh: 小写字母、数字与连字符；它是这台服务器每个工具的前缀

mcp_none.en: this building reaches no tool server
mcp_none.zh: 这栋楼还没有工具服务器

mcp_servers.zh: 这栋楼能连到的服务器

mcp_shelf_asking.en: asking which applications can be connected
mcp_shelf_asking.zh: 正在查哪些应用可以连接

mcp_shelf_needs_key.en: store a project key above, and the applications it can connect appear here
mcp_shelf_needs_key.zh: 先在上面存入项目密钥，它能连接的应用就会出现在这里

mcp_why_command.en: write the command that starts it

mcp_why_grammar.en: lowercase letters, digits and dashes only
mcp_why_grammar.zh: 只能用小写字母、数字与连字符

mcp_why_pair_name.en: a value needs a name beside it

mcp_why_taken.en: this scope already reaches a server by that name
mcp_why_taken.zh: 这个作用域已经有同名的服务器

mcp_why_url.en: write the url it answers on

palette_transcribe.en: speak, transcribed into the message box

part_error_host.en: that host is not a valid DNS name
part_error_host.zh: 这个主机名不是合法的 DNS 名

part_remove_detail.en: its key stays in the credential store
part_remove_detail.zh: 它的密钥仍留在凭据库里

part_remove_endpoint.zh: 要移除这个 endpoint 吗？

part_unkept.en: This draft lives in this tab only: the browser would not store it, and closing the tab loses it.
part_unkept.zh: 这份草稿只在这个标签页里：浏览器没有存下它，关掉标签页它就没了。

path_reveal_inert.en: this build cannot open a path outside the city

plan_empty.en: no plan yet: the Mayor hands each building its part of the city's plan
plan_empty.zh: 还没有计划：市长会把城市计划中属于这栋楼的部分交给它

plan_node_elsewhere.en: {n} more runs claimed a node with this number in another building, or before this page
plan_node_elsewhere.zh: 另有 {n} 个 run 认领过同号的节点，在别的楼，或早于此页

plan_node_unclaimed.en: no run in this building has claimed this node
plan_node_unclaimed.zh: 这栋楼里还没有 run 认领过这个节点

plan_unplanned.en: no plan to measure against: {steps} steps taken
plan_unplanned.zh: 没有可度量的计划：已走 {steps} 步

provider_cut.en: the answer stopped part-way; the same request is worth sending again
provider_cut.zh: 回答中途断了，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_exchange.en: the request never completed; the same request is worth sending again
provider_exchange.zh: 请求没有完成，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_overflow.en: the conversation no longer fits this model's window (the provider answered {status}); start a new session that keeps the summary, or choose a model with a larger window
provider_overflow.zh: 对话已经放不进这个模型的窗口（供应方回答 {status}）：开一个带摘要的新会话，或换一个窗口更大的模型

provider_quota.en: this account's quota is used up (the provider answered {status}); add credit to it, or add another account to this provider
provider_quota.zh: 这个账号的额度已经用完（供应方回答 {status}）：给它充值，或给这个 Provider 再添一个账号

provider_refused.en: the provider refused with {status}; check this endpoint's model name, key and dialect
provider_refused.zh: 供应方以 {status} 拒绝了请求：检查这个接口的模型名、密钥和接口形态

provider_refused_busy.en: the provider answered {status}: busy or broken for now; the same request is worth sending again
provider_refused_busy.zh: 供应方回答 {status}，表示它此刻忙或出了故障，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_reported.en: the provider reported an error part-way through its answer
provider_reported.zh: 供应方在回答中途报了错

provider_silence.en: the provider went silent mid-answer; the same request is worth sending again
provider_silence.zh: 供应方回答到一半不再出声，同一个请求值得再发一次

provider_unbuilt.en: this side could not build the request; check this endpoint's base_url and extra headers
provider_unbuilt.zh: 这一侧没能造出请求：检查这个接口的 base_url 和附加请求头

provider_unreadable.en: the provider answered in a shape the city cannot read; check this endpoint's dialect
provider_unreadable.zh: 供应方的回答城读不懂：检查这个接口的接口形态

rec_archive_nothing.en: nothing filed matches this search; what a building's runs produce is filed here
rec_archive_nothing.zh: 归档里没有与之相符的东西；楼里各次 run 的产出会归档在这里

event_run_forked.en: a run was branched from another
event_run_forked.zh: 从另一次 run 开出一个分支

event_result_offloaded.en: a long result was set aside
event_result_offloaded.zh: 一段过长的结果被另存

event_steer_received.zh: 你给一次 run 追加了话

event_cancel_received.en: a run was asked to stop
event_cancel_received.zh: 有人要求一次 run 停下

event_watchdog_fired.en: the watchdog stopped a stalled run
event_watchdog_fired.zh: 看门狗叫停了一次停滞的 run

event_budget_limit.zh: 一次 run 花到了预算上限

event_signal_wait_started.en: a run began waiting for a reply
event_signal_wait_started.zh: 一个 run 开始等回信

event_signal_wait_ended.en: a run stopped waiting for a reply
event_signal_wait_ended.zh: 一个 run 不再等回信

event_draft_held.en: a draft was held for review

event_draft_resolved.zh: 被扣下的草稿有了结果

event_roadmap_claimed.zh: 认领了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_finished.zh: 完成了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_released.en: a roadmap item was let go
event_roadmap_released.zh: 放下了一项路线图条目

event_approval_requested.zh: 一次 run 请求批准

event_cross_building_transfer.zh: 有东西在两栋楼之间转交

event_backpressure_shed.zh: 负载过高，丢下了一些活

event_credential_lent.en: a credential was lent to a run
event_credential_lent.zh: 把一份凭据借给了一次 run

event_secret_captured.en: a secret was caught and vaulted
event_secret_captured.zh: 截下一份密钥并存入保险库

event_secret_egress_blocked.en: a secret was stopped from leaving
event_secret_egress_blocked.zh: 拦下了一份要外发的密钥

event_discard_restored.zh: 找回了一个丢弃的文件

event_went_back.en: a run went back to an earlier step
event_went_back.zh: 一次 run 退回到先前一步

event_prompt_shape_compared.zh: 比较了两种 prompt 形状

event_roadmap_split.zh: 拆分了一项路线图条目

event_roadmap_blocked.zh: 一项路线图条目被卡住

event_toolkit_link_opened.zh: 打开了一个工具包链接

event_cache_renewed.zh: 续了一次 prompt 缓存

event_harness_reported.en: a harness reported what it was doing
event_harness_reported.zh: harness 汇报了它在做的事

event_remote_session_started.en: a device started a remote session
event_remote_session_started.zh: 一台设备开始了远程会话

event_proposal_offered.en: a run proposed a change to a document
event_proposal_offered.zh: 一次运行对一份文档提出了修改

event_proposal_decided.zh: 一处修改提案已有决定

event_proposal_withdrawn.en: a run withdrew its proposed change
event_proposal_withdrawn.zh: 一次运行收回了它的修改提案

registry_empty.en: nothing has been filed for keeping
registry_empty.zh: 还没有东西被登记留存

registry_note.en: What runs filed for keeping, newest first.
registry_note.zh: run 登记留存的东西，新的在前。

release_ahead.en: newer than the newest available through this install channel ({version}).
release_ahead.zh: 比当前安装渠道提供的最新版本（{version}）更新。

release_behind.en: a newer release is published: {version}, cut {released}.
release_behind.zh: 已经有更新的版本：{version}，{released} 切出。

release_current.en: this is the newest release published. Nothing to do.
release_current.zh: 这就是已发布的最新版本，不用动。

release_mine.zh: 这座城市跑的是 {version}，{released} 切出

release_source.en: this city was built from source, so it is none of the published releases.
release_source.zh: 这座城市是从源码构建的，因此不属于任何一个已发布版本。

remote_about.en: The remote door lets a phone or a second computer reach this city from outside its network. It is opened, and devices are paired and revoked, at the city's own console and nowhere else: no page, device or resident can do it.
remote_about.zh: 远程门让手机或另一台电脑从这座城的网络之外够到它。开门、配对与撤销设备只在城自己的控制台上做，别处都做不了：页面、设备与居民都不能。

remote_verb_open.en: opens the door for a while and prints the address a device opens
remote_verb_open.zh: 把门开一段时间，印出设备要打开的地址

remote_verb_pair.en: prints a code a device scans, good once, for ten minutes
remote_verb_pair.zh: 印出一个设备扫的码，只用一次，十分钟内有效

remote_verb_devices.en: lists the devices paired with this city
remote_verb_devices.zh: 列出与这座城配对过的设备

remote_verb_revoke.en: forgets a device; its sessions end
remote_verb_revoke.zh: 忘掉一台设备，它的会话随之结束

remote_verb_close.en: closes the door; paired devices stay paired
remote_verb_close.zh: 关上门；配对过的设备仍是配对的

remote_route.en: The door needs an https:// route, named in the [remote] table of the city's own CONFIG.toml; docs/operating.md shows the two kinds.
remote_route.zh: 门要一条 https:// 的通路，写在城自己的 CONFIG.toml 的 [remote] 表里；docs/operating.md 写了两种通路的写法。

remote_not_paired.en: This browser holds no device for this city. On a phone, scan the code /remote pair prints.
remote_not_paired.zh: 这个浏览器里没有这座城的设备。在手机上扫 /remote pair 印出的码。

remote_invited_about.en: This device makes its own key and proves it to the city. The code in the link is used once; the city never sees this device's private key.
remote_invited_about.zh: 这台设备自己生成密钥，并向城证明它持有这把钥匙。链接里的码只用一次；城从不见到这台设备的私钥。

remote_unreadable.en: This link does not read as an invitation. Scan the code on the city's console again.
remote_unreadable.zh: 这个链接读不成一份邀请。在城的控制台上重新扫码。

remote_lacks_insecure.en: Pairing needs an https:// address, and this page was opened at another kind.
remote_lacks_insecure.zh: 配对要一个 https:// 的地址，而这一页不是从那样的地址打开的。

remote_lacks_crypto.en: This browser cannot hold a device key: its WebCrypto lacks Ed25519 or X25519.
remote_lacks_crypto.zh: 这个浏览器存不了设备密钥：它的 WebCrypto 没有 Ed25519 或 X25519。

remote_lacks_storage.en: This browser keeps no IndexedDB for this page, so a paired key would be lost at once.
remote_lacks_storage.zh: 这个浏览器不给这一页 IndexedDB，配对得到的钥匙会立刻丢掉。

remote_seed_about.en: Shown once and kept nowhere. Reinstalling this page means pairing again.
remote_seed_about.zh: 只显示这一次，哪里都不保存。重装这一页就要重新配对。

remote_persist_refused.en: The browser did not promise to keep this page's storage. It may clear it when space runs short, and then this device pairs again.
remote_persist_refused.zh: 浏览器没有答应保留这一页的存储。空间吃紧时它可能清掉，那时这台设备要重新配对。

remote_locked.en: The door is locked. Paired devices stay paired; the console opens it again.
remote_locked.zh: 门锁上了。配对过的设备仍是配对的；在控制台上可以再开。

remote_forget_detail.en: This browser drops its key. The city still knows the device until /remote revoke at its console.
remote_forget_detail.zh: 这个浏览器丢掉它的钥匙。在城的控制台上 /remote revoke 之前，城仍记着这台设备。

remote_unkept.en: This browser could not keep the device, so it is not paired here. Pair again with a fresh code.
remote_unkept.zh: 这个浏览器存不下这台设备，所以这里没有配对成功。换一个新码重新配对。

remote_refused_fingerprint.en: The city that answered is not the one the code names, so the code never left this device. Scan again; if this repeats, the route is changing what it forwards.
remote_refused_fingerprint.zh: 答话的城不是码里指的那一座，所以码没有离开这台设备。重新扫码；反复出现说明通路在改动它转发的内容。

remote_refused_signature.en: The city's answer is not signed by its key, so the code never left this device. Scan again; if this repeats, the route is changing what it forwards.
remote_refused_signature.zh: 城的回答不是它的钥匙签的，所以码没有离开这台设备。重新扫码；反复出现说明通路在改动它转发的内容。

remote_refused_length.en: The city speaks another version of the remote door. Reload the page.
remote_refused_length.zh: 城说的是另一个版本的远程门。重新载入这一页。

remote_refused_agreement.en: The key exchange did not agree. Start again; if it repeats, pair again.
remote_refused_agreement.zh: 密钥交换没有对上。再来一次；反复出现就重新配对。

remote_refused_key.en: This browser's key would not sign. Reload the page and pair again.
remote_refused_key.zh: 这个浏览器的钥匙签不出。重新载入这一页，再配对一次。

remote_closed_denied.en: The door refused: the code was used or has expired, or the door is closed. Run /remote pair at the console again.
remote_closed_denied.zh: 门拒绝了：码已用过或已过期，或者门关着。在控制台上重新 /remote pair。

remote_closed_silent.en: The door ended the connection without saying why.
remote_closed_silent.zh: 门结束了这次连接，没有说原因。

remote_unreachable.en: Nothing answers here. Is the door open, and is this the address the console printed?
remote_unreachable.zh: 这里没有回答。门开着吗？这是控制台印出的那个地址吗？

run_no_prompt.en: this run has no prompt on record
run_no_prompt.zh: 这次 run 没有留下提示

run_prompt_gone.en: the store no longer holds these bytes
run_prompt_gone.zh: 仓库里已经没有这段的字节了

sandbox_arm_help.en: A named boundary must be available. Platform default keeps this machine’s existing choice.
sandbox_arm_help.zh: 指定的边界必须可用；选择平台默认时沿用宿主平台的既有机制。

sandbox_container_help.en: Uses Docker or Podman with a prepared local immutable image. Runtime never pulls images. Each start checks network, user, mounts and resource limits; unavailable or refused boundaries fail closed.
sandbox_container_help.zh: 使用 Docker 或 Podman 与已准备的本地固定镜像。运行时不拉取镜像。每次启动前检查网络、用户、挂载与资源限额；无法提供所选边界时拒绝执行。

sandbox_container_needed.en: Enter the full local image ID and every nonzero limit.
sandbox_container_needed.zh: 请填写完整本地镜像 ID 和全部非零限额。

sandbox_env_help.en: One variable name per line that a child process may inherit, on top of the four every run gets.
sandbox_env_help.zh: 每行一个变量名，子进程可以继承，在每个 run 都有的四个之外。

sandbox_fuel_help.en: Instruction budget for one sandboxed call.
sandbox_fuel_help.zh: 一次沙箱调用的指令预算。

sandbox_fuel_needed.en: fuel is a whole number above zero
sandbox_fuel_needed.zh: 燃料须是大于零的整数

sandbox_inherited.en: This building has no sandbox of its own, so the city's holds. Saving writes one, whole.
sandbox_inherited.zh: 这栋楼没有自己的沙箱，由城那一层管。保存会写下完整的一份。

sandbox_mounts_help.en: One city address per line, readable on top of the building. Where a run may write is decided elsewhere.
sandbox_mounts_help.zh: 每行一个城内地址，在这栋楼之外额外可读。run 能写哪里另有规定。

sandbox_shell_help.en: Whether a run may be offered a shell line at all. A shell line is the one call whose reach cannot be read off its arguments.
sandbox_shell_help.zh: 是否给 run 提供 shell 命令。shell 是唯一一种无法从参数读出它能碰到什么的调用。

sandbox_trusted_help.en: One MCP server label per line that may reach what no checkpoint puts back, such as the desktop of the computer the city runs on.
sandbox_trusted_help.zh: 每行一个 MCP 服务器标签，允许它碰到检查点放不回去的东西，例如运行这座城的电脑的桌面。

sandbox_unknown.en: the city has not answered yet

sandbox_what.en: What a run in this building may touch. The card is written whole: every face below is what the building's sandbox will say.
sandbox_what.zh: 这栋楼里的 run 能碰到什么。整张卡一起写入：下面每一项都是这栋楼的沙箱将要说的。

setup_account_id_shape.zh: 只能用小写字母和数字

setup_account_id_taken.en: this id is already listed; edit that account instead
setup_account_id_taken.zh: 这个 id 已在列表里，请改为编辑那个账号

setup_account_key_environment.en: key from an environment variable, read-only
setup_account_key_environment.zh: 密钥来自环境变量，只读

setup_account_key_environment_help.en: this key is read from an environment variable; change it there
setup_account_key_environment_help.zh: 这个密钥从环境变量读取，请在那里修改

setup_account_key_environment_unusable.zh: 环境变量已设，但密钥不可用

setup_account_key_kept.en: leave blank to keep the stored key
setup_account_key_kept.zh: 留空即保留已存的密钥

setup_account_key_route.en: The key goes straight to the vault; this page keeps only the reference the city answers with.
setup_account_key_route.zh: 密钥直接存进密钥库，本页只保留城返回的引用。

setup_account_not_sent.en: not sent: the link to the city is down; the draft is kept
setup_account_not_sent.zh: 没有发出：与城的连接断了，草稿保留

setup_account_only.en: a provider keeps at least one account
setup_account_only.zh: 供应方至少要留一个账号

setup_accounts_legacy.en: This provider still uses the one key it was attached with. Saving an account replaces that key with this list, so enter the same key again as the first account.
setup_accounts_legacy.zh: 这个供应方还在用接入时填的那一个密钥。保存账号后，这个列表会取代它，所以请把同一个密钥再填一次，作为第一个账号。

setup_accounts_order.en: A new session takes the first usable account in this list and stays on it while it answers; the order decides only new sessions and where a request goes after an account fails.
setup_accounts_order.zh: 新会话取列表里第一个可用的账号，只要它还在回答就一直用它；顺序只决定新会话用哪个，以及一个账号出错后换到哪个。

setup_accounts_order_search.en: Each search starts from the first usable account in this list; the order decides which account is asked first and where a search goes after an account fails.
setup_accounts_order_search.zh: 每次搜索都从列表里第一个可用的账号开始；顺序决定先问哪个账号，以及一个账号出错后换到哪个。

setup_account_forget_offer.en: the key of {id} is still in the vault
setup_account_forget_offer.zh: {id} 的 Key 还在 vault 里

setup_account_forget_sent.en: deleting the key; the city refuses while something else still names it
setup_account_forget_sent.zh: 正在删除 Key；还有别处在用它时城会拒绝

setup_account_retries_fallback.en: nothing chosen: the city retries an account {n} before it moves to the next
setup_account_retries_fallback.zh: 未选择：城在一个账号上重试 {n} 后再换下一个

search_card_note.en: which outside service the web_search tool of every run sends its queries to; written to the city's CONFIG.toml
search_card_note.zh: 每个 run 的 web_search 工具把查询发给哪一家外部服务；写进城的 CONFIG.toml

search_default_at.en: Exa, free and needs no key: {url}

search_no_fallback.en: when the selected service fails, the query is not sent to Exa or to another service instead
search_no_fallback.zh: 选中的服务失败时，查询不会改发给 Exa 或另一家

search_confidential.en: a confidential building is never offered web search, so nothing a run there reads is sent to an outside service as a query
search_confidential.zh: confidential 楼不提供网络搜索，那里的 run 读到的内容不会作为查询发给外部服务

search_override.en: the hall's own files state a different [search] ({choice}, from the {layer} layer); this card edits the city's file and does not change that
search_override.zh: hall 自己的文件另有 [search]（{choice}，来自 {layer} 一层）；本卡只改城的文件，不改它

search_in_use.en: this is the service in use

search_only.en: the only service; choose default or off to stop using it
search_only.zh: 只剩这一家；要停用请选默认或关闭

search_remove_in_use.en: in use; choose another service first

search_required.en: the address, the remote tool name and the query parameter are required
search_required.zh: 地址、远端工具名与 query 参数名必填

search_id_taken.en: another service has this id; edit that one instead
search_id_taken.zh: 已有一家用这个 id；改为编辑那一家

setup_base_url_normalised.en: normalised from {entered}; the city calls the URL above
setup_base_url_normalised.zh: 已从 {entered} 归一；城调用的是上面那个地址

setup_display_name_help.en: shown instead of the id; leave blank to use the id
setup_display_name_help.zh: 界面上显示它而不是标识；留空即用标识

setup_effort_city.en: the city's own [model] effort in CONFIG.toml holds until a dispatch states a level for the session it opens
setup_effort_city.zh: 城自己的 CONFIG.toml [model] effort 一直生效，直到某次派活为它开的那一场另说一个档位

setup_effort_essay.en: A run freezes its effort when it starts, so a change made now reaches the next run and never the one already going, and each change invalidates the prompt cache the provider built for this conversation. The two wire formats spell the six levels alike but put none in different places: Anthropic disables thinking through a field of its own, OpenAI passes none as the effort itself. Choosing nothing is not the same as choosing none - an unstated effort leaves the decision to the provider, and none turns thinking off.
setup_effort_essay.zh: 一次 run 在起点冻结它的强度，此刻的改动因此只到下一次 run，永远到不了正在跑的那一次；每改一次，供应方为这段对话建好的 prompt 缓存都会作废。两种兼容格式的六档拼写一致，none 的位置却不同：Anthropic 用一个自己的字段关掉思考，OpenAI 把 none 当作强度本身传过去。不选与选 none 是两件事——不选是把决定权留给供应方，选 none 是把思考关掉。

setup_group_hint_tools.en: the programs this city must find
setup_group_hint_tools.zh: 这座城必须找到的程序

setup_group_hint_skills.en: what the residents have been taught

setup_group_hint_run.en: what a run may do on this machine
setup_group_hint_run.zh: 一次运行被允许做什么

setup_group_hint_network.en: what leaves this machine, and through what

setup_group_hint_remote.en: Pairing a phone or a second computer with this city through the remote door.
setup_group_hint_remote.zh: 经远程门，让手机或另一台电脑与这座城配对。

setup_group_hint_keys.en: the keyboard, and what each key does
setup_group_hint_keys.zh: 键盘，以及每个键做什么

setup_group_hint_appearance.en: how this page looks to you

setup_group_hint_advanced.en: the welcome walk, from its first step

setup_group_hint_accounts.en: who the city may call, and with which key
setup_group_hint_accounts.zh: 城能调用谁，用哪把钥匙

setup_group_hint_harnesses.en: a subscription reaches the city through its vendor's own harness, signed in there
setup_group_hint_harnesses.zh: 订阅经厂商自己的 harness 进城，在那里登录

setup_group_hint_you.en: what the city calls you and the Mayor; a change takes effect in the next session
setup_group_hint_you.zh: 城怎么称呼你与市长；改动在下一个会话生效

setup_group_hint_rules.en: what a building's runs are allowed, in its RULES.toml
setup_group_hint_rules.zh: 一栋楼里的 run 被允许做什么，写在它的 RULES.toml

setup_group_hint_automation.en: what the city starts by itself, from SCHEDULE.toml and WATCH.toml
setup_group_hint_automation.zh: 城自己开始的事，来自 SCHEDULE.toml 与 WATCH.toml

settings_next_run.en: takes effect for the runs that start after this
settings_next_run.zh: 此后开始的 run 生效

saving_refused.en: not saved: the city refused it

saving_unverified.en: sent, but no receipt came back; check before saving again
saving_unverified.zh: 已发出但没等到回执，待核对

you_person_note.en: what the city calls you, and what you want its agents to know about you; kept in PREFERENCES.md
you_person_note.zh: 城怎么称呼你，以及你希望 Agent 知道的背景；存在 PREFERENCES.md

you_mayor_note.en: the name the Mayor goes by; kept in MAYOR.md
you_mayor_note.zh: 市长对外的名字；存在 MAYOR.md

you_mayor_address.en: its address stays hall/mayor: a name changes what it is called, not what it may do
you_mayor_address.zh: 它的地址仍是 hall/mayor：名字只改称呼，不改职责

you_next_session.en: takes effect in new sessions; a session already going keeps the name it started with
you_next_session.zh: 新会话生效；已经开始的会话沿用开始时的名字

you_unreadable.en: the identity area does not read

you_unreadable_open.en: fix it in the documents that govern the city
you_unreadable_open.zh: 到治理城的文档里改正

you_import_note.en: runs gh on the machine the city runs on, not on this browser's; only the login is read, and nothing is kept until you save the card
you_import_note.zh: 在运行城的那台机器上执行 gh，不是这个浏览器所在的机器；只读登录名，保存这张卡之前什么都不写

you_import_no_cli.en: gh is not installed on the city's machine; type your ID instead
you_import_no_cli.zh: 城的机器上没有装 gh；请直接输入你的 ID

you_import_signed_out.en: gh is not signed in to {host} on the city's machine; sign in there, or type your ID
you_import_signed_out.zh: 城的机器上 gh 没有登录 {host}；到那里登录，或直接输入 ID

you_import_not_a_host.en: {host} is not a host gh knows
you_import_not_a_host.zh: gh 不认识 {host} 这台主机

you_import_failed.en: gh failed (exit {exit}); type your ID instead
you_import_failed.zh: gh 运行失败（退出码 {exit}）；请直接输入 ID

rules_building.en: the building whose rules are shown

rules_note.en: the whole file, written at once; the city reads it before it lands and refuses one it cannot read
rules_note.zh: 整份文件一次写入；城先读过再落盘，读不懂的会被拒绝

automation_by_hand.en: SCHEDULE.toml and WATCH.toml are edited by hand at the city's root; this page only reads them
automation_by_hand.zh: SCHEDULE.toml 与 WATCH.toml 在城的根目录手改；这一页只读

admission_title.zh: 什么约束一个 run 的产出

admission_note.en: three values, chosen apart for each dispatch, that combine
admission_note.zh: 三个值，每次派活分别选，可以组合

admission_write_says.en: what the run may change: full writes as usual; create may only add new files and never overwrite one
admission_write_says.zh: run 能改什么：full 照常写；create 只能新建文件，不能覆盖任何已有文件

admission_require_says.en: the evidence the work must carry before a merge lets it in; choosing one does not provide it, and the building's own checks still run
admission_require_says.zh: 合入前产出必须带的证据；选了要求不等于有了证据，楼自己的校验照跑

admission_landing_says.en: whether the work lands: ordinary takes the usual road, experiment stays in its worktree and never lands
admission_landing_says.zh: 产出是否落地：ordinary 走常规路，experiment 留在它的工作树里，永不落地

admission_apart.en: the write limit says what may change; the landing policy says whether the change enters the project
admission_apart.zh: 写入限制回答能改什么，落地策略回答改动是否进入项目

setup_id_help.en: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; the key reference derives from it
setup_id_help.zh: 小写字母、数字与连字符；密钥引用由它派生

setup_key_stored.en: a key is already stored under this name; leave blank to keep it
setup_key_stored.zh: 此名下已有密钥，留空则沿用

setup_key_vault_note.en: clearing forgets the reference here; the vault keeps the key until it is written over
setup_key_vault_note.zh: 清除只让这一页忘掉引用；密钥库里的密钥要被覆盖才会改变

setup_manual_ids.en: model ids this endpoint does not list
setup_manual_ids.zh: 端点没有列出的模型 id

setup_model_needed.en: An empty ceiling is safe to leave empty. Where the provider's model list states one, the city uses it. Otherwise, on the OpenAI-compatible formats the request carries no ceiling and the provider applies its own default for that model, usually the largest it allows; on the Anthropic-compatible format, which needs a number, the city takes the vendor's documented figure, then its policy default. Type a number here only to set your own.
setup_model_needed.zh: 上限可以留空。供应方的模型列表写了上限，城就用它；没写时，OpenAI 兼容格式的请求不带上限，由供应方按这个模型取它自己的缺省，通常就是它允许的最大值；Anthropic 兼容格式必须带一个数，城先取厂商文档写的上限，再落到策略缺省。只有想自己定时才在这里填数。

setup_network_default.en: the rule a new endpoint starts with

setup_network_new_only.en: An endpoint attached from now on starts with this rule. One already attached keeps the rule it was attached with, and changing that means attaching it again.
setup_network_new_only.zh: 从现在起加入的端点以这一档开始。已经加入的端点保持它当初那一档，要改就得重新加一次。

setup_next_config.en: one field above is not a shape the city accepts
setup_next_config.zh: 上面某个字段的写法这座城不接受

setup_next_credential.en: no key is stored under this id: type one, then look again
setup_next_credential.zh: 这个标识下没有密钥：填一把，然后再看一次

setup_next_dialect.en: this endpoint does not speak the wire_api chosen above
setup_next_dialect.zh: 这个端点不说上面选的接口形态

setup_next_other.en: nothing on this form can act on this; copy the details
setup_next_other.zh: 这张表单对此无从下手；复制细节

setup_next_provider.en: check base_url and the key, then list models again
setup_next_provider.zh: 核对 base_url 与密钥，然后再取一次模型列表

setup_next_timeout.en: nothing came back in time: check the proxy, then base_url
setup_next_timeout.zh: 等待期间没有任何回应：先查代理，再查 base_url

setup_probe_busy.zh: 正在问 {host} 提供哪些模型…

setup_proxying_help.en: Which of this endpoint's calls go through the proxy this machine is configured with.
setup_proxying_help.zh: 这个端点的哪些调用走这台电脑配置的代理。

setup_proxying_note_always.en: Every call follows the proxy, including one to an address on this machine. Choose this when a relay on this machine has to see every request.
setup_proxying_note_always.zh: 每一次调用都按代理走，包括打到这台电脑自己的地址。当这台电脑上的中继必须看到每一个请求时选它。

setup_proxying_note_except_local.en: An address on this machine is reached directly; everything else follows the proxy variables and the system setting. If you have not thought about proxies, this is the setting you want.
setup_proxying_note_except_local.zh: 打到这台电脑自己的地址直连，其余按代理变量与系统设置走。没有专门考虑过代理的话，要的就是这一档。

setup_proxying_note_never.en: No call follows a proxy, whatever this machine is configured with. Choose this when a virtual network adapter already carries every packet.
setup_proxying_note_never.zh: 无论这台电脑怎么配置，任何调用都不走代理。当虚拟网卡已经在承载全部流量时选它。

setup_reach_key.en: the provider refused the key: check it, then look again
setup_reach_key.zh: 供应方拒绝了这把密钥：核对之后再看一次

setup_reach_name.en: this host name cannot go into a TLS handshake: an underscore, or a character that is not ASCII
setup_reach_name.zh: 这个主机名进不了 TLS 握手：有下划线，或者有非 ASCII 字符

setup_reach_ok.en: the provider answered; what it serves is below
setup_reach_ok.zh: 供应方答了；它供应什么在下面

setup_reach_path.en: the provider answered 404: base_url carries a path it should not
setup_reach_path.zh: 对方答了 404：base_url 末尾带了一段不该有的路径

setup_reach_refused.en: the port refused the connection: check the port, and whether the server is running
setup_reach_refused.zh: 端口拒绝了连接：核对端口，以及那个服务是否在跑

setup_reach_resolver.en: the resolver itself failed: this machine cannot look names up right now
setup_reach_resolver.zh: 解析器自己失败了：机器现在查不了主机名

setup_reach_silent.en: nothing answered in time: a firewall or a proxy that is not running
setup_reach_silent.zh: 等待期间没有任何应答：多半是防火墙，或者一个没跑起来的代理

setup_reach_socket.en: the connection could not be opened; the detail beside this line says why
setup_reach_socket.zh: 连接开不起来；这一行旁边的细节说了原因

setup_reach_status.en: the provider answered with a status this form cannot act on; copy the details
setup_reach_status.zh: 供应方答了一个这张表单处置不了的状态；复制细节

setup_reach_tls.en: the handshake failed: this machine does not trust the certificate
setup_reach_tls.zh: 握手失败：机器不信任那张证书

setup_reach_unknown_host.en: this name does not resolve: check the spelling, or the proxy
setup_reach_unknown_host.zh: 这个主机名解析不出来：核对拼写，或者核对代理

setup_reach_unreachable.en: the request never reached a handshake

setup_governed_note.en: each run reads these when it starts; a run already going keeps what it was given
setup_governed_note.zh: 每次 run 开始时读它们；已经在跑的 run 仍用开始时拿到的内容

governed_preferences.en: how you want the city run

setup_toml_unread.en: the city's CONFIG.toml states nothing yet
setup_toml_unread.zh: 城的 CONFIG.toml 还什么都没写

setup_transcribe.en: transcribe · hears (needs an ASR model such as whisper; a text model cannot go here)
setup_transcribe.zh: transcribe · 听写（需要 ASR 模型，如 whisper；文本模型不能填这里）

setup_ocr.en: ocr · reads images (needs a model that takes images; a text-only model cannot go here)
setup_ocr.zh: ocr · 读图（需要能收图片的模型；只收文字的模型不能填这里）

setup_wire_api_unsupported.en: this city speaks chat and messages; it cannot call a responses endpoint
setup_wire_api_unsupported.zh: 这座城会说 chat 与 messages，还不能调用 responses 端点

skills_empty.en: no shelf in this city holds anything: a skill is a folder with a SKILL.md placed on a shelf
skills_empty.zh: 这座城的书架上还什么都没有：技能是放在书架上、带 SKILL.md 的文件夹

skills_missing.en: admitted but not on any shelf

skills_unopened.en: open a skill above to read it here
skills_unopened.zh: 在上面打开一个技能，就在这里读它

slash_dispatch.en: open a run with these words

slash_effort.en: how hard the model thinks before it answers
slash_effort.zh: 模型作答前想得多用力

slash_fork.en: branch this conversation from a turn you pick, or from the newest run of [addr]; the original stays as it is
slash_fork.zh: 从你选的一轮开分支，带地址时从那个房间最新的 run 开；原对话保持不变

slash_model.zh: 把 main 指向另一个模型

slash_new_fresh.en: start a new session with no handoff
slash_new_fresh.zh: 开新对话，不携带交接摘要

slash_compact.en: stop the run here, then start a new session that carries its handoff
slash_compact.zh: 先停下这里的 run，再开一个带着交接摘要的新对话

slash_tag.en: give the session in view a tag
slash_tag.zh: 给眼前这段对话加一个标签

slash_untag.en: take a tag off the session in view
slash_untag.zh: 去掉眼前这段对话的一个标签

slash_new.en: start a new session at this address
slash_new.zh: 在此地址开一个新对话

slash_raise.en: raise a building from a template

slash_release.en: let a stopped building or city work again
slash_release.zh: 让停下的楼或城重新开工

slash_steer.en: say this into the run that is going
slash_steer.zh: 把这句话说进正在跑的 run

slash_stop.en: cancel the run that is going
slash_stop.zh: 取消正在跑的这次 run

take_back_detail.en: The file in the working tree becomes what checkpoint {oid} holds, and goes away if that checkpoint has no such file. What {path} says now is in no checkpoint.
take_back_detail.zh: 工作树里的这个文件会变成检查点 {oid} 里的样子；那个检查点里没有这个文件时，它会被移走。{path} 现在的内容不在任何检查点里。

take_back_not_in_tree.en: this path is not a file of the city
take_back_not_in_tree.zh: 这个路径不是城里的文件

talk_delivery_held.en: not connected - sent when the city is back

talk_delivery_unknown.en: the connection dropped before the city answered - not sent again
talk_delivery_unknown.zh: 城回答之前连接断了，不会重发

talk_wear_hint.en: Map of this conversation: each tick is a round, coloured by what it did; the darker line is what you have read; press to go there
talk_wear_hint.zh: 这段对话的地图：每个刻点是一个回合，颜色表示它做了什么；较深的线是你读过的部分；按下去就跳到那里

talk_failed_refused.en: the city did not take this message

talk_failed_model.en: no model is chosen to answer
talk_failed_model.zh: 还没有选回答用的模型

talk_failed_provider.en: the model provider refused the call
talk_failed_provider.zh: 模型供应方拒绝了这次调用

talk_room_note_mayor.en: the Mayor: plans the city and hands out work
talk_room_note_mayor.zh: 市长：给整座城做计划、派活

talk_room_note_building.en: the building itself: a message opens a new room in it
talk_room_note_building.zh: 这栋楼本身：消息会在楼里开一个新房间

talk_room_note_room.en: a room in {building}: carries on the conversation there
talk_room_note_room.zh: {building} 楼里的一个房间：接着那里的对话说

talk_goal.en: read the city, answer, and plan where planning is needed
talk_goal.zh: 读完这座城，回答，需要计划的地方写计划

talk_listening_note.en: what the room's newest run was told, segment by segment; the whole text is on its run page
talk_listening_note.zh: 房间里最新的 run 被告知的四段；全文在它的 run 页

talk_opening_mayor.en: plans, work to hand out, and what the city should do next
talk_opening_mayor.zh: 计划、派活，以及这座城接下来做什么

inspect_split.en: height of the editor, in lines

inspect_raw_head.en: the original is {bytes}; this is its head

inspect_line_beyond.en: line {n} is past the head the city sent of this {bytes} file
inspect_line_beyond.zh: 第 {n} 行在城发来的开头之外，文件共 {bytes}

inspect_shot_reading.en: reading the picture from the city…

inspect_shot_lost.en: The city no longer holds this picture, so it is not drawn.
inspect_shot_lost.zh: 城不再存有这张图，所以画不出。

inspect_call_gone.en: This call is not in its run's rounds.
inspect_call_gone.zh: 这次 run 的回合里没有这次调用。

talk_said_nothing_capped.zh: 模型没有输出（输出上限 {n}）

talk_unreadable.zh: 第 {at} 条记录读不回来

tree_no_runs.en: no runs yet in this room

wait_deny_keeps.en: deny stops the work and undoes nothing; files a run deleted are kept in the recycle bin.
wait_deny_keeps.zh: 拒绝只停下这件活，不撤销已经发生的事；run 删掉的文件留在回收站里。

welcome_note.en: Five steps. Only the first is required; the others can wait, and the settings bring you back to any of them.
welcome_note.zh: 五步。只有第一步必做；其余可以稍后再做，设置里随时能回到任何一步。

guide_step_provider.en: connect a provider and choose the main model

guide_step_provider_about.en: Pick a provider or a local endpoint, give it the credentials it asks for, then choose the model the main tag answers with. The other roles keep their defaults until you change them.
guide_step_provider_about.zh: 选择 provider 或本地端点，填上它要的凭据，再为 main 选一个对话模型。其他角色保持默认，以后再改。

guide_step_dependencies_about.en: What the machine running the city has and lacks for its work. Installs run there, one item at a time, and a failed one blocks nothing else.
guide_step_dependencies_about.zh: 运行城市的主机为城里的工作装了什么、缺什么。安装就在那台主机上一项一项进行，某一项失败不拦住别的。

guide_step_texts_about.en: The documents that tell residents who you are and how the Mayor works. Each saves on its own, and a name takes effect in new sessions.
guide_step_texts_about.zh: 告诉居民你是谁、市长怎么工作的几份文档。每份单独保存，称呼在新会话里生效。

guide_step_skills_about.en: Skills sit on shelves: the city library, a building's own shelf, or an outside folder mounted read-only. A skill on a shelf is not yet one a building may use.
guide_step_skills_about.zh: skill 放在书架上：城库、某栋楼自己的书架，或只读挂载的外部目录。上了书架，不等于某栋楼已经允许使用。

guide_step_mcp_about.en: Tool servers a building may reach, added by command, by address or as JSON, and checked before anyone uses them.
guide_step_mcp_about.zh: 楼能够到的工具服务器，按命令、地址或 JSON 加入，用之前先测连接。

guide_start_needs_main.en: the conversation needs a main model first
guide_start_needs_main.zh: 先选定主模型，才能开始对话

whose_not_oid.en: a commit id is 40 characters, each 0-9 or a-f
whose_not_oid.zh: 提交 id 是 40 个字符，每个是 0-9 或 a-f

wire_frame_undecodable.en: this page speaks wire v{ours} and the server sent a frame it cannot read
wire_frame_undecodable.zh: 本页说 wire v{ours}，而服务端送来的这一帧它读不了

wire_out_of_order.en: the server streamed frames before completing the handshake
wire_out_of_order.zh: 服务端在握手完成之前就开始推帧

wire_read_frame_action.en: read a frame from this city
wire_read_frame_action.zh: 读取这座城发来的一帧

wire_read_record_action.en: read a record from this city
wire_read_record_action.zh: 读取这座城写下的一条记录

wire_record_undecodable.en: this page cannot read the {at} field of a record the city wrote
wire_record_undecodable.zh: 本页读不出这座城写下的记录里的 {at} 字段

wire_reload_for_client.en: reload the page to fetch the client this server was built with
wire_reload_for_client.zh: 刷新页面，取回与这台服务端一同构建的客户端

wire_reload_or_wrong_host.en: reload the page; if it repeats, the address is not a sprawling server
wire_reload_or_wrong_host.zh: 刷新页面；若仍如此，这个地址不是一台 sprawling 服务端

wire_version_mismatch.en: this page speaks wire v{ours} and the server speaks v{theirs}
wire_version_mismatch.zh: 本页说 wire v{ours}，服务端说 v{theirs}

err_e_config_invalid.en: the city cannot use a model here

fork_here_hint.en: Branch from here: a new session carries the conversation up to this point, and this conversation stays as it is
fork_here_hint.zh: 从这里开分支：新会话带着到这里为止的对话，原对话保持不变

ui_browser_path.en: a browser at a path I name

err_e_tool_unavailable.en: this tool is not available right now

err_e_invalid_args.en: the city could not make sense of this request

err_e_outside_write_domain.en: this write falls outside the allowed ground
err_e_outside_write_domain.zh: 这次写入超出了允许的范围

err_e_version_conflict.en: the ground changed under this one

err_e_gate_denied.zh: 一条规则拦下了这件事

err_e_budget_exhausted.en: this run has spent all it may
err_e_budget_exhausted.zh: 这次运行的预算已经花完

err_e_timeout.en: this took too long and was cut
err_e_timeout.zh: 这件事等得太久，已被切断

err_e_provider_accounts_exhausted.en: every account of this provider failed
err_e_provider_accounts_exhausted.zh: 这个供应方的每个账号都没答上来

err_e_evidence_missing.en: the city needs to see the work first

err_e_loop_suspected.en: the city suspected a loop and stopped
err_e_loop_suspected.zh: 城怀疑陷入循环，已停手

err_e_sandbox_denied.en: the sandbox would not allow this

err_e_draft_stale.en: the draft is behind the file

err_e_tainted_action.en: tainted input cannot be acted on
err_e_tainted_action.zh: 被污染的输入不能照做

err_e_approval_pending.en: this is waiting for a signature

err_e_digest_suspect.en: the city cannot vouch for these bytes
err_e_digest_suspect.zh: 城无法为这些字节背书

err_e_storage_fatal.en: the city cannot write anything down

err_e_browser_unavailable.en: there is no browser to open it with
err_e_browser_unavailable.zh: 没有可以打开它的浏览器

err_e_endpoint_dialect_unsupported.zh: 这个端点说的是另一种兼容格式

err_e_wire_mismatch.en: the client and the city disagree on the wire
err_e_wire_mismatch.zh: 客户端与城的协议版本对不上

err_e_log_version_unsupported.en: this ledger is written in a version this city cannot read
err_e_log_version_unsupported.zh: 这本账本的版本这座城读不了

err_e_secret_egress.en: a secret would have left the city

err_e_backpressure_shed.en: the city shed this to stay live
err_e_backpressure_shed.zh: 城丢掉了它以保持运转

fork_pending.en: branch from turn {turn} · what you send next starts it, and the original conversation stays as it is
fork_pending.zh: 分支自第 {turn} 轮 · 下一句会在这条分支里发出，原对话保持不变

fork_keeps.en: the original conversation stays as it is

fork_safe_point.en: that call is still open · branching from the last safe point
fork_safe_point.zh: 这次调用还没有回话 · 从最近的安全点开分支

setup_language_note.en: the language every word here is said in
setup_language_note.zh: 这里所有字句用哪种语言

setup_autonomy_note.en: who answers what this city puts in front of the User
setup_autonomy_note.zh: 这座城递给 User 决定的事由谁答复

appearance_face_note.en: the face the prose is set in

appearance_mono_note.en: the face ids, keys and paths are set in
appearance_mono_note.zh: id、密钥与路径用哪个字体

appearance_body_note.en: how large a line of body text is

appearance_density_note.en: how much air the spacing steps carry

appearance_chroma_note.en: how much colour the screen takes

appearance_blend_note.en: how much of the world layer shows beside the conversation in the blend tier
appearance_blend_note.zh: 混合档里，对话两侧的世界层显出多少

appearance_glass_note.en: whether the edge keys let the page behind them show through
appearance_glass_note.zh: 左下三键是否透出背后的页面

appearance_tier_note.en: how much of the world layer the page draws; the layers key moves through the same three
appearance_tier_note.zh: 页面画出多少世界层；图层键在同样的三档之间切换

setup_key_kept.en: archived - leave blank to keep it

part_remove_server_detail.en: this building stops using the tools it offers
part_remove_server_detail.zh: 这栋楼将不再使用它提供的工具

desktop_unchanged.en: there is nothing to save yet

act_no_target.en: this refusal names nothing to act on
act_no_target.zh: 这次拒绝没有指名对象

act_ask_plan.en: ask the mayor for a plan

form_ask_plan.en: Write a plan for {building} whose ready steps work towards: {name}
form_ask_plan.zh: 为 {building} 写一份计划，让它的就绪步骤朝向：{name}

no_run_in_front.en: no run is going on this page
no_run_in_front.zh: 这一页上没有在跑的 run

stop_whole_city.en: To stop the whole city, type /halt --all; /release --all lets it go on.
stop_whole_city.zh: 要停下整座城，输入 /halt --all；/release --all 放行。

palette_no_harvey.en: no command called harvey. The city is still yours to change.
palette_no_harvey.zh: 没有叫 harvey 的命令。不过这座城，仍由你来改变。

palette_no_tafuri.en: no command called tafuri. There is no design here, only its critique.
palette_no_tafuri.zh: 没有叫 tafuri 的命令。这里没有设计，只有对设计的批判。

err_e_model_unchosen.en: no main model is chosen yet

link_lost_detail.zh: 正在重连 · 第 {n} 次

link_unsent.en: {n} held until the city is back

setup_notify_note.en: When this window is away, raise a notification for each new approval that waits for you. Nothing else is raised.
setup_notify_note.zh: 这个窗口不在前台时，每有一件新的待批事项等你决定，就弹一条通知。别的事不弹。

setup_editor_note.en: A file the monitor shows opens at its line in the editor this computer has. The browser hands the link to the editor; the city starts nothing.
setup_editor_note.zh: 监视器里的文件会在这台电脑的编辑器里打开，并跳到那一行。链接由浏览器交给编辑器，城不启动任何程序。

setup_editor_folder.en: The city's folder on this computer
setup_editor_folder.zh: 城在这台电脑上的文件夹

setup_editor_folder_help.en: An absolute path. Only a file inside it gets a link.
setup_editor_folder_help.zh: 填绝对路径。只有这个文件夹里的文件会有链接。

change_line_quote.zh: 在对话里引用第 {n} 行

decided_none.en: nothing has been answered for you
decided_none.zh: 还没有代为答复过任何事

bld_halt_idle.en: nothing runs here now; halting refuses new work
bld_halt_idle.zh: 这栋楼现在没有在跑的派活；叫停会拒收新活

runs_counts.zh: {asking} 个在等你 · 共 {runs} 个 run

runs_legend.zh: 每个 run 在做什么

runs_tree.en: every run in the city, by building and room
runs_tree.zh: 全城的 run，按楼与房间排

runs_keys.en: j and k move, h and l fold, Enter opens
runs_keys.zh: j、k 上下移动，h、l 折叠与展开，Enter 打开

gallery_runs_board.en: the runs board, with runs waiting for the User
gallery_runs_board.zh: 全城 run 板，有 run 在等 User

gallery_runs_many.en: the runs board with 1,200 runs: only the rows on screen are drawn
gallery_runs_many.zh: 1200 个 run 的全城 run 板：只画屏幕上的行

slash_halt.en: stop one building, or the whole city, until released
slash_halt.zh: 停下某栋楼或整座城，直到放行

slash_diff.en: open the changes of the run in this room
slash_diff.zh: 打开此房间 run 的改动

slash_admit.en: the evidence the next run's work must carry before a merge lets it in
slash_admit.zh: 下一个 run 的工作在合入之前要带的证据

slash_room.en: open the conversation of another room
slash_room.zh: 打开另一个房间的对话

ask_late_title.en: no answer came back to the {query} question
ask_late_title.zh: {query} 这个问题没有等到回答

talk_write_switch.en: full write instead of create only
talk_write_switch.zh: 常规写入（关闭时只读可新建）

bld_remove_busy.en: stop the runs here before removing this building
bld_remove_busy.zh: 先停下这里在跑的派活，再移走这栋楼

bld_remove_detail.en: Its files move to .sprawling/removed and its history stays in the ledger. Move the folder back to the city root and adopt it to bring it back.
bld_remove_detail.zh: 它的文件搬到 .sprawling/removed，历史留在 ledger 里。把文件夹搬回城的根目录再收编，就能找回。

machine_spare.en: one of a kind that needs only one, and another is here
machine_spare.zh: 同类有一个即可，已经有了

machine_source_cargo.en: source code from crates.io, compiled by cargo on this computer
machine_source_cargo.zh: 从 crates.io 下载源码，由 cargo 在这台电脑上编译

machine_source_elan.en: downloaded from the Lean project by elan
machine_source_elan.zh: 由 elan 从 Lean 官方下载

machine_source_rustup.en: downloaded from the Rust project by rustup
machine_source_rustup.zh: 由 rustup 从 Rust 官方下载

machine_source_uv.en: a python-build-standalone build, downloaded by uv
machine_source_uv.zh: 由 uv 下载的 python-build-standalone 构建

machine_source_winget.en: installed through winget, the Windows package manager
machine_source_winget.zh: 经 winget（Windows 的包管理器）安装

setup_effort_unstated.en: in force at {addr}: no level stated, so the provider decides
setup_effort_unstated.zh: {addr} 现在没有写档位，由供应方决定

setup_effort_where.en: to choose another level for one conversation, use the third box under the composer
setup_effort_where.zh: 要为一段对话另选档位，用对话框下方的第三格

results_city.en: {runs} runs · {rest} still working or set aside, not listed
results_city.zh: {runs} 个 run · 其余 {rest} 个在干活或已放下，不列出

showing_note.en: Results only draws your words in a room, the answers, the endings and what they produced, and the city's waiting, failed and finished runs. The switch on either page changes this too.
showing_note.zh: 只看结果时，房间只画你的话、回答、结局与产出，城只列等你、失败、刚完成三类。两页上的开关也会改这一项。

run_river.en: where the time went, by turn

run_calls_axis.en: UTC when it answered · how long
run_calls_axis.zh: UTC 答复时刻 · 用时

mon_ceiling_hit.en: memory ceiling of {limit} bytes reached: an allocation in this run was refused, which may be why the command failed (Settings › Performance)
mon_ceiling_hit.zh: 撞到了 {limit} 字节的内存上限：这个 run 里有一次分配被拒，命令可能因此失败（设置 › 性能）

mon_ceiling_unapplied.en: the memory ceiling of {limit} bytes did not apply to this command: {why}
mon_ceiling_unapplied.zh: {limit} 字节的内存上限没有作用在这条命令上：{why}

mon_ceiling_unread.en: memory ceiling of {limit} bytes: whether this run reached it cannot be read
mon_ceiling_unread.zh: {limit} 字节的内存上限：读不出这个 run 是否撞到了它

mon_ceiling_why_not_delegated.en: this machine does not delegate its cgroup to the city
mon_ceiling_why_not_delegated.zh: 城所在机器的 cgroup 没有委派给城

mon_ceiling_why_platform.en: this platform has no memory ceiling for a run
mon_ceiling_why_platform.zh: 这个平台没有按 run 的内存上限

mon_ceiling_why_refused.en: the operating system refused the ceiling or the means to see it reached
mon_ceiling_why_refused.zh: 操作系统拒绝了这个上限，或拒绝了读出撞限的手段

mon_ceiling_why_unjoined.en: the command did not join its run's job or cgroup; a container command is held by the building's container limits
mon_ceiling_why_unjoined.zh: 这条命令没有进入 run 的 job 或 cgroup；容器里的命令由楼的容器限额管

mon_paused.zh: 已暂停，按 F 继续跟随

mon_lines_cut.en: {n} more lines are in the ledger

ask_unfiled.en: reload the page to fetch the client this city was built with; report it if a reload does not settle it
ask_unfiled.zh: 刷新页面，取回这座城配套的客户端；若刷新后依旧如此，请把它报上来

finder_none.zh: 这里没有哪个文件名含有「{text}」。

finder_cut.en: Only part of this tree was looked at; a file not listed may match too.
finder_cut.zh: 只看了这棵树的一部分，没列出的文件也可能匹配。

mode_note_chat.en: talk with the resident; it answers what you say
mode_note_chat.zh: 和居民说话；它就你说的话作答

mode_note_work.en: carry out the task towards the goal you state
mode_note_work.zh: 朝你说的目标把这件事做完

city_table_row.en: {name}: {waiting} waiting for you, {working} at work, {done} done
city_table_row.zh: {name}：{waiting} 个等你，{working} 个在干活，{done} 个完成

gallery_city_table_narrow.en: city · the building table at a phone's width
gallery_city_table_narrow.zh: 城 · 手机宽度下的楼表

recover_e_path_not_found.en: Check the path against the city's tree; paths are relative to the city root.
recover_e_path_not_found.zh: 对照城里的目录树核对这条路径；路径从城的根目录算起。

recover_e_tool_unknown.en: Use one of the tools this building lists for its residents.
recover_e_tool_unknown.zh: 改用这栋楼给居民列出的工具之一。

recover_e_tool_unavailable.en: Install what the tool needs on the dependencies page, or use another tool.
recover_e_tool_unavailable.zh: 在依赖项页面装上这件工具要的程序，或者改用别的工具。

recover_e_invalid_args.en: Correct the request as the detail below says, then send it again.
recover_e_invalid_args.zh: 按下面的详情改正这次请求，再发一次。

recover_e_outside_write_domain.en: Write inside the building's own ground, or widen what it may write in its RULES.toml.
recover_e_outside_write_domain.zh: 写在这栋楼自己的范围里，或者在它的 RULES.toml 里放宽它能写的地方。

recover_e_version_conflict.en: Read the file again and redo the change against what it says now.
recover_e_version_conflict.zh: 重新读一遍这个文件，按它现在的内容再改一次。

recover_e_gate_denied.en: The rule in the detail below says what is allowed; ask for that instead, or change the rule.
recover_e_gate_denied.zh: 下面详情里的规则说明了什么是允许的；改成那样再做，或者改规则本身。

recover_e_budget_exhausted.en: Raise the spending limit on the run page, or start a new run.
recover_e_budget_exhausted.zh: 在 run 页面调高花费上限，或者另起一次 run。

recover_e_timeout.en: Try again; if it keeps taking this long, check the network and the provider's status.
recover_e_timeout.zh: 再试一次；如果总是这么久，检查网络和供应方的状态。

recover_e_provider.en: Check the provider's key and status on the model settings page, then send again.
recover_e_provider.zh: 在模型设置页面检查供应方的密钥和状态，然后再发一次。

recover_e_provider_accounts_exhausted.en: On the model settings page, file a key or add credit for one of this provider's accounts, or add another account, then send again.
recover_e_provider_accounts_exhausted.zh: 在模型设置页面为这个供应方的某个账号补存密钥或充值，或者新增一个账号，然后再发一次。

recover_e_evidence_missing.en: Let the run show the work first: a test, a diff or a file it wrote.
recover_e_evidence_missing.zh: 先让 run 拿出做过的证据：一次测试、一份改动或它写下的文件。

recover_e_loop_suspected.en: Read the last steps on the run page, then steer the run with a narrower ask.
recover_e_loop_suspected.zh: 在 run 页面看看最后几步，再用更具体的要求引导它。

recover_e_locator_invalid.en: Point at a file by its path in the city, or at a stored block by its full name.
recover_e_locator_invalid.zh: 用城里的路径指向一个文件，或者用完整的名字指向一个已存的块。

recover_e_sandbox_denied.en: Run it on the host instead, or allow it in the building's sandbox rules.
recover_e_sandbox_denied.zh: 改到沙箱外运行，或者在这栋楼的沙箱规则里允许它。

recover_e_busy.en: Wait for the run in this room to finish, or stop it, then send again.
recover_e_busy.zh: 等这个房间里的 run 做完，或者先停下它，再发一次。

recover_e_draft_stale.en: Read the file again and write the draft against its current text.
recover_e_draft_stale.zh: 重新读一遍这个文件，按它现在的文字重写草稿。

recover_e_goal_conflict.en: Change the request to fit the building's goal, or change the goal first.
recover_e_goal_conflict.zh: 把请求改得合乎这栋楼的目标，或者先改目标。

recover_e_tainted_action.en: The User has to confirm this step: its input came from outside the city.
recover_e_tainted_action.zh: 这一步要由 User 确认：它的输入来自城外。

recover_e_repair_busy.en: Wait for the running repair to finish, then try again.
recover_e_repair_busy.zh: 等正在进行的修复做完，再试一次。

recover_e_delegation_depth.en: Do the work in this run, or hand it to a room nearer the top.
recover_e_delegation_depth.zh: 在这次 run 里自己做完，或者交给离顶层更近的房间。

recover_e_approval_pending.en: Allow or refuse the request under approvals; the run waits until you do.
recover_e_approval_pending.zh: 到审批里允许或拒绝这项请求；在那之前 run 会一直等。

recover_e_approval_denied.en: The request was refused; ask for something else, or ask again with a reason.
recover_e_approval_denied.zh: 这项请求被拒绝了；改要别的，或者说明理由再请求一次。

recover_e_cross_building_denied.en: Signal a resident of that building with the question instead of reaching in.
recover_e_cross_building_denied.zh: 别直接伸进那栋楼，改给那里的居民发信号去问。

recover_e_digest_suspect.en: Fetch the bytes again from their source; the stored copy does not match its name.
recover_e_digest_suspect.zh: 从来源重新取这些字节；存下的副本和它的名字对不上。

recover_e_credential_missing.en: File the key on the model settings page, then attach the provider again.
recover_e_credential_missing.zh: 在模型设置页面存入密钥，再重新接上这个供应方。

recover_e_model_unchosen.en: Attach a provider on the model settings page and pick a model for it.
recover_e_model_unchosen.zh: 在模型设置页面接上一个供应方，并为它选一个模型。

recover_e_config_invalid.en: Fix the setting named in the detail below, on the settings page or in its file.
recover_e_config_invalid.zh: 在设置页面或它所在的文件里，改正下面详情里点名的那项设置。

recover_e_cas_corrupt.en: Run sprawling doctor; it names the damaged objects and how to restore them.
recover_e_cas_corrupt.zh: 运行 sprawling doctor；它会点名损坏的对象，并说明怎样恢复。

recover_e_storage_fatal.en: Free disk space or fix the folder's permissions, then restart the city.
recover_e_storage_fatal.zh: 腾出磁盘空间或修好这个目录的权限，然后重启这座城。

recover_e_worktree_busy.en: Wait for the other run working in this tree to finish, then try again.
recover_e_worktree_busy.zh: 等在这棵工作树里干活的另一次 run 做完，再试一次。

recover_e_browser_unavailable.en: Install a browser the city can drive; the dependencies page lists them.
recover_e_browser_unavailable.zh: 装一个城能驱动的浏览器；依赖项页面列出了可用的几种。

recover_e_endpoint_dialect_unsupported.en: Pick the format this provider speaks on the model settings page.
recover_e_endpoint_dialect_unsupported.zh: 在模型设置页面选这个供应方用的兼容格式。

recover_e_wire_mismatch.en: Reload the page to get the client this city was built with.
recover_e_wire_mismatch.zh: 重新加载页面，取回这座城配套的客户端。

recover_e_log_version_unsupported.en: Open this city with the newer sprawling that wrote its ledger.
recover_e_log_version_unsupported.zh: 用写下这本账的较新版本的 sprawling 打开这座城。

recover_e_ledger_held.en: Another sprawling process holds this city's ledger; stop it, then start this one.
recover_e_ledger_held.zh: 另一个 sprawling 进程占着这座城的账本；先停下它，再启动这一个。

recover_e_history_unproven.en: The city is still proving the history it opened from; send it again once the log says the history is proved.
recover_e_history_unproven.zh: 城还在证明它打开时读到的历史；等日志说历史已证明，再发一次。

recover_e_secret_egress.en: Keep the key in the vault and pass it as a secret: reference instead of its value.
recover_e_secret_egress.zh: 把密钥留在钥匙库里，传 secret: 引用而不是它的值。

recover_e_discard_irreversible.en: Keep a copy first if you may need it; this discard cannot be taken back.
recover_e_discard_irreversible.zh: 如果以后还可能要用，先留一份副本；这次丢弃收不回来。

recover_e_backpressure_shed.en: Free disk space or wait for queued runs to finish, then send again.
recover_e_backpressure_shed.zh: 腾出磁盘空间或等排队的 run 做完，再发一次。

recover_e_tool_outcome_unknown.en: Check whether the step took effect before running it again.
recover_e_tool_outcome_unknown.zh: 先确认这一步有没有生效，再决定要不要重做。

recover_e_plan_missing.en: Ask the Mayor to write a plan for this goal in the building's Roadmap.md.
recover_e_plan_missing.zh: 请市长在这栋楼的 Roadmap.md 里为这个目标写一份计划。

world_pinned_mayor.en: The Mayor's current session is always pinned
world_pinned_mayor.zh: 市长当前这段对话总是置顶

world_tag_hint.en: One word: letters, digits, - or _, at most 24
world_tag_hint.zh: 一个词：字母、数字、- 或 _，至多 24 个

world_tags_offline.en: Tags are kept by the city, and the city is not connected
world_tags_offline.zh: 标签由城保管，而城没有连上

talk_past.en: An earlier session of {room}. It is read-only: the city goes on with the room's current session.
talk_past.zh: {room} 较早的一段对话，只读：城只接着这个房间当前的一段说下去。

world_price.en: {input} in / {output} out, as the provider quotes it

world_no_session.en: No session has run in this room yet.
world_no_session.zh: 这个房间还没有跑过会话。

world_commits_more.en: older commits are on the page of {building}
world_commits_more.zh: 更早的提交在 {building} 的楼页上

mailbox_why_ask.en: Here because of the refusal E_APPROVAL_PENDING: a door waits for the User's own hand, and the run waits with it.
mailbox_why_ask.zh: 在这里是因为拒绝 E_APPROVAL_PENDING：一扇门等 User 亲自动手，run 跟着等。

mailbox_why_failure.en: Here because of the refusal {code}: the work stays stopped until the User acts, and the city does not retry it.
mailbox_why_failure.zh: 在这里是因为拒绝 {code}：User 动手之前工作一直停着，城不会自己重试。

mailbox_why_question.en: Here because of the event approval_requested: a resident asks the User to approve a step it may not take alone.
mailbox_why_question.zh: 在这里是因为事件 approval_requested：一位居民请 User 批准一步它不能独自走的操作。

mailbox_why_proposal.en: Here because of the event proposal_offered: a run offered this change instead of writing the document, and the card stays open until the User accepts or rejects it.
mailbox_why_proposal.zh: 在这里是因为事件 proposal_offered：run 没有直接改这份文稿，而是提出了这处修改；User 接受或拒绝之前，卡一直开着。

setup_skills_how.en: put a skill in a section folder on either shelf - a folder with a SKILL.md, such as engineering/review/SKILL.md - then name it in the building's RULES.toml so its runs read it
setup_skills_how.zh: 把技能放进任一书架下的分区文件夹：一个带 SKILL.md 的文件夹，例如 engineering/review/SKILL.md；再在楼的 RULES.toml 里写上它的名字，这栋楼的 run 才会读它

skills_empty_next.en: no shelf this building reads holds a skill yet: put a folder with a SKILL.md into the city's library or this building's shelf - Settings, Skills shows both folders - and it appears here
skills_empty_next.zh: 这栋楼读的书架上还没有技能：把带 SKILL.md 的文件夹放进城的书库或这栋楼的书架（两个文件夹在「设置 → 技能」里），它就会出现在这里

world_rename_hint.en: Shown in place of the address. Leave it empty to show the address again
world_rename_hint.zh: 代替地址显示。留空则重新显示地址

letter_gone.en: This letter is no longer open: it was answered, or the document moved past it.
letter_gone.zh: 这封信已不再待决：它已被回复，或文稿已越过它。

setup_group_hint_colours.en: Your own colours laid over the built-in theme. They are kept in your preferences, so every browser that opens this city draws them.
setup_group_hint_colours.zh: 在内置主题之上换用你自己的颜色。它们存在你的偏好里，打开这座城的每个浏览器都会用上。

colours_tokens_note.en: Every colour token the page is drawn with. A change takes effect at once.
colours_tokens_note.zh: 页面所用的每个颜色 token。改动立即生效。

colours_css_note.en: CSS laid after the theme and your colours. Apply it with the button or the save key.
colours_css_note.zh: 排在主题与你的颜色之后的 CSS。用按钮或保存键应用。

colours_restore_note.en: Removes every colour and the stylesheet you laid over the theme.
colours_restore_note.zh: 删掉你加在主题上的全部颜色与样式表。

colours_short.en: {token} reaches Lc {reached} where its text needs {claimed}; it may be hard to read.
colours_short.zh: {token} 只有 Lc {reached}，它的文字需要 {claimed}；可能难以看清。

colours_foreign.en: {token} is not a colour of this theme and has no effect.
colours_foreign.zh: {token} 不是这个主题的颜色，不起作用。

colours_fine.en: Every text colour is legible on the brightest surface it sits on.
colours_fine.zh: 每种文字颜色在它所在的最亮表面上都清晰可读。

machine_version_unreadable.en: answered its version in a form that is not text

machine_version_late.en: did not say its version in time

machine_fault_half_written.en: is only half there: an install stopped part way
machine_fault_half_written.zh: 只装了一半：某次安装中途停了

machine_fault_will_not_start.en: is here but will not start:

machine_fault_unreadable.en: is here but cannot be read:

machine_absence_variable.en: the variable names a place where it is not:
machine_absence_variable.zh: 变量指向的地方没有它：

machine_absence_no_home.en: its home directory could not be found

machine_absence_build.en: this build of sprawling does not include it
machine_absence_build.zh: 这一版 sprawling 没有带它

machine_scan_title.en: Scanning in front of the city

machine_scan_not_windows.en: Does not apply: macOS and Linux run no system scanner in front of every write, so there is nothing to read here. Windows reads Defender and the Dev Drive.
machine_scan_not_windows.zh: 不适用：macOS 与 Linux 没有在每次写入前扫描的系统组件，这里没有可读的。Windows 上读 Defender 与 Dev Drive。

machine_scan_stopped.en: off on this computer, so nothing slows the city's writes
machine_scan_stopped.zh: 这台电脑上关着，城的写入不会被拖慢

machine_scan_drive_trusted.en: the city is on a trusted Dev Drive
machine_scan_drive_trusted.zh: 城在一个受信任的 Dev Drive 上

machine_scan_drive_untrusted.en: a Dev Drive that is not trusted, so Defender still scans it:
machine_scan_drive_untrusted.zh: 是 Dev Drive，但没有受信任，Defender 仍会扫描：

machine_scan_outside.en: no exclusion holds the city, so Defender scans each write
machine_scan_outside.zh: 没有排除项覆盖城，Defender 会扫描每次写入

machine_scan_inside.en: the city is inside an exclusion:

machine_untold_no_disk.en: not read: the city's directory is on no local disk
machine_untold_no_disk.zh: 没读到：城目录不在本地磁盘上

machine_untold_admin_only.en: not read: only an administrator can ask
machine_untold_admin_only.zh: 没读到：只有管理员才能问

machine_untold_unread.en: not read: this command's answer could not be read:
machine_untold_unread.zh: 没读到：读不懂这个命令的回答：

machine_untold_failed.zh: 没读到：这个命令失败了：

machine_untold_unstarted.en: not read: this command did not start:
machine_untold_unstarted.zh: 没读到：这个命令没起来：

machine_untold_unanswered.en: not read: this command did not answer in time:
machine_untold_unanswered.zh: 没读到：这个命令没有及时回答：

harness_not_set_up.en: not installed or not signed in

release_registry_unasked.en: not asked: the city has no rule yet for comparing its versions with this one
release_registry_unasked.zh: 没问：城还没有拿它的版本与这一版比较的规则

release_channel_cargo.zh: 通过 cargo install 安装

release_channel_archive.en: Installed from the release archive. To update, run:
release_channel_archive.zh: 从发行压缩包安装。要更新，运行：

release_channel_source.en: Built from source. To update, pull the repository and build again.
release_channel_source.zh: 从源码构建。要更新，拉取仓库后重新构建。

remote_steps.en: Pair a device, step by step
remote_steps.zh: 一步一步配对一台设备

remote_step_open.en: At the city's console, open the door. The console prints the address the device opens.
remote_step_open.zh: 在城的控制台上开门。控制台印出设备要打开的地址。

remote_step_pair.en: At the console, name the device. The console prints a QR code and a link, good once for ten minutes.
remote_step_pair.zh: 在控制台上给设备起个名字。控制台印出一个二维码和一条链接，只用一次，十分钟内有效。

remote_step_device.en: On the other device, scan the code or open the link. The link looks like this; the page it opens says Pair this device.
remote_step_device.zh: 在另一台设备上扫码或打开链接。链接长这样；打开的页面写着「配对这台设备」。

remote_step_seed.en: Press Pair on the device. It shows a seed once, in groups of four letters; write it down, then press the button under it.
remote_step_seed.zh: 在设备上按「配对」。它只显示一次种子，四个字母一组；抄下来，再按它下面的按钮。

remote_restart_unknown.en: When the city's computer restarts: on Windows and macOS the pairing stays, kept by Credential Manager or the Keychain; on Linux it lasts until the computer reboots, unless the city uses the encrypted vault file. Open the dependencies page to see which this city has.
remote_restart_unknown.zh: 城所在的电脑重启时：Windows 与 macOS 上配对仍在，由凭据管理器或钥匙串保管；Linux 上只到这次开机结束，除非这座城用加密的 vault 文件。打开依赖项页能看到这座城是哪一种。

remote_restart_kept.en: When the city's computer restarts, paired devices stay paired: the system's credential store keeps the city key.
remote_restart_kept.zh: 城所在的电脑重启后，配对过的设备仍是配对的：系统的凭据存放处保管着城钥匙。

remote_restart_passphrase.en: When the city's computer restarts, paired devices stay paired once you type the vault's passphrase at start.
remote_restart_passphrase.zh: 城所在的电脑重启后，启动时输入 vault 口令，配对过的设备就仍是配对的。

remote_restart_until_reboot.en: When the city's computer reboots, every device pairs again: the kernel keyring keeps the city key only until then. An encrypted vault file keeps it across reboots.
remote_restart_until_reboot.zh: 城所在的电脑重启后，每台设备都要重新配对：内核的 keyring 只保管城钥匙到那时。用加密的 vault 文件就能跨重启保留。

remote_restart_process.en: When the city restarts, every device pairs again: no system credential store answered, so the city key lives only in the city's memory.
remote_restart_process.zh: 城重启后，每台设备都要重新配对：没有系统凭据存放处应答，城钥匙只在城的内存里。

copy_note.en: Puts this on the clipboard exactly as written: {text}
copy_note.zh: 把这段原样放进剪贴板：{text}

remote_verb_replace_key.en: makes a new city key; every device pairs again
remote_verb_replace_key.zh: 换一把新的城钥匙，每台设备都要重新配对

release_check_registries.zh: 去 npm 与 crates.io 查

release_refused_registries.en: Neither npm nor crates.io could be asked, so nothing here was checked.
release_refused_registries.zh: npm 与 crates.io 都没能问到，所以这里什么都没有核对过。

remote_door_about.en: Opening the door and replacing the city key each ask for a one-time code that the city prints on its own console, the terminal where sprawling serve runs; a page or a resident's tool cannot read it. Closing needs no code.
remote_door_about.zh: 开门与更换城钥匙都要一个只用一次的确认码，城把它印在自己的控制台上，也就是跑着 sprawling serve 的那个终端；页面和居民的工具都读不到它。关门不要码。

remote_door_open_note.en: asks the city to open the remote door for the time chosen beside it; the city then prints a code on its console
remote_door_open_note.zh: 请城把远程门开到旁边选的时长；城随后在控制台上印一个确认码

remote_door_close_note.en: closes the remote door now and ends every remote session; no code is needed
remote_door_close_note.zh: 现在关上远程门，结束每一个远程会话；不要确认码

remote_key_replace_note.en: makes a new city key; every paired device must pair again, and revoked devices stay revoked
remote_key_replace_note.zh: 换一把新的城钥匙；每台配对过的设备都要重新配对，撤销过的设备仍是撤销的

remote_key_where.en: The city key rests in the city's vault: Windows Credential Manager and the macOS Keychain keep it across restarts; on Linux the kernel keyring keeps it until the computer reboots, unless the city uses the encrypted vault file.
remote_key_where.zh: 城钥匙放在城的 vault 里：Windows 凭据管理器与 macOS 钥匙串跨重启保管；Linux 的内核密钥环只保管到这次开机结束，除非城用加密的 vault 文件。

remote_door_code_help.en: type the eight-character code the city has just printed on its console; Esc cancels
remote_door_code_help.zh: 输入城刚在控制台上印出的 8 个字符；Esc 取消

remote_door_confirm_note.en: sends the code back to the city, which then does what was pressed
remote_door_confirm_note.zh: 把确认码交回城，城随后做按下的那件事

remote_door_denied.en: the code was wrong, already used, or expired; press again and type the new code the console prints
remote_door_denied.zh: 码不对、已用过或已过期；再按一次，输入控制台上新印的码

remote_door_no_console.en: the city has no console to print a code on; run sprawling serve in the city's own terminal
remote_door_no_console.zh: 城没有可以印码的控制台；在城自己的终端里跑 sprawling serve

remote_door_unknown.en: this city does not carry the door commands yet; update the city, or use the console
remote_door_unknown.zh: 这座城还不认识门的命令；更新城，或在控制台上做

remote_door_done_door.en: the code was sent; the city's console says whether the door opened
remote_door_done_door.zh: 确认码已送出；门开没开，城的控制台上写着

remote_door_done_key.en: the code was sent; the city's console says whether the key was replaced
remote_door_done_key.zh: 确认码已送出；钥匙换没换，城的控制台上写着

remote_door_closing.en: the close was sent; the city's console says when the door closed
remote_door_closing.zh: 关门已送出；门何时关上，城的控制台上写着

context_second_building.en: the building whose second reminder is shown
context_second_building.zh: 显示哪栋楼的第二级提醒

remote_door_unsent.en: the page is not connected to the city, so nothing was sent; try again once it reconnects
remote_door_unsent.zh: 页面没有连上城，所以什么也没送出；重新连上后再试

world_cache_unknown.en: unknown: the provider did not report its cache
world_cache_unknown.zh: 未知：provider 没有报告缓存

format_docx_revisions_one.en: 1 tracked change, shown as its result

inbox_count_one.en: 1 signal waiting for a run here
inbox_count_one.zh: 1 条信号在等这里的 run 读

run_awaiting_reply_due.zh: 在等 {room} 回信，已过时限

event_signal_landed.zh: 一个信号到了它的房间

machine_enables_pwsh.en: the exec tool's shell arm under PowerShell 7, where a building's CONFIG.toml sets interpreter = "pwsh"
machine_enables_pwsh.zh: exec 工具的 shell 一支改用 PowerShell 7，用于 CONFIG.toml 写了 interpreter = "pwsh" 的楼

usage_mcp_title.zh: 每个工具服务器的使用

usage_reaudit.en: content changed since its last audit: audit it again
usage_reaudit.zh: 内容在上次审核之后改过：请重新审核

usage_version.en: content {digest} read from {when}, first by run {run}
usage_version.zh: 内容 {digest}，自 {when} 起被读，第一个读它的 run 是 {run}

letter_whole_talk.en: the whole conversation, on the run's page
letter_whole_talk.zh: 整段会话在 run 页上

usage_skills_none.en: no skill is on a shelf, and no run has read one
usage_skills_none.zh: 书架上没有 skill，也没有 run 读过 skill

usage_mcp_none.en: no building names a tool server, and no run has called one
usage_mcp_none.zh: 没有楼配置工具服务器，也没有 run 调用过

shells_title.zh: 各解释器的 shell 行

shells_none.en: no shell line has run yet
shells_none.zh: 还没有跑过 shell 行

release_channel_unknown.en: Confirm the original installer before choosing an update command.
release_channel_unknown.zh: 选择更新命令前，请确认原安装方式。

release_channel_package.en: Package directory: choose the original npm or Bun installer.
release_channel_package.zh: 包目录：请选择原来使用的 npm 或 Bun 安装器。

release_channel_cargo_or_binstall.en: Cargo directory: choose cargo install or cargo-binstall.
release_channel_cargo_or_binstall.zh: Cargo 目录：请选择原来使用的 cargo install 或 cargo-binstall。

release_origin_unconfirmed.en: The install origin is not confirmed; no newest version is selected.
release_origin_unconfirmed.zh: 安装来源尚未确认，因此未选定用于比较的最新版本。

performance_core.zh: 核心线程与 run 的命令

performance_memory.zh: 每个 run 的内存上限（字节）

performance_memory_invalid.en: Enter a positive whole number of bytes, or leave empty for no ceiling.
performance_memory_invalid.zh: 填写正整数字节数，或留空表示不限。

performance_memory_note.en: Empty means unlimited; there is no default ceiling. Enter a positive whole number of bytes; it applies only with soft with memory ceiling, to all commands of one run together, and hitting it is reported as an error on the command.
performance_memory_note.zh: 留空不限，没有缺省上限。填写正整数字节数；仅在“软放置与内存上限”下生效，同一 run 的全部命令合用，撞到时命令上会报错。

performance_none_note.en: Do not request CPU placement or per-run CPU weight. Thread priority is set separately.
performance_none_note.zh: 不请求 CPU 放置或 run CPU 权重；线程优先级另设。

performance_normal_note.en: Keep core threads at normal priority. Placement and sandbox limits are separate settings.
performance_normal_note.zh: 核心线程用正常优先级；放置与沙箱限制另行设置。

performance_pinned_note.en: Windows requests hard affinity to the placement plan and the remaining processors for run jobs. Linux reports a taskset command to use at startup; macOS does not pin.
performance_pinned_note.zh: Windows 为核心请求放置计划的硬亲和，并为 run job 请求余下处理器；Linux 报告需在启动时使用的 taskset 命令，macOS 不固定处理器。

performance_raised_note.en: Request above-normal priority for hot core threads. The operating system may refuse the request.
performance_raised_note.zh: 请求提高核心热线程优先级；操作系统可能拒绝。

performance_restart.en: Restart the city server to apply these settings.
performance_restart.zh: 重启城服务以应用设置。

performance_soft_note.en: Prefer the fastest cores on Windows, lift power throttling, and request equal CPU weight for runs. Platform support varies.
performance_soft_note.zh: Windows 上优先使用最快核、解除节能限流，并请求 run 等 CPU 权重；能力依平台而定。

performance_soft_shares_note.en: Soft placement plus the memory ceiling you enter below, shared by all commands of each run; empty means no ceiling. An allocation above it fails inside that run, and the command's result and the terminal say the ceiling was reached. Windows jobs and delegated Linux cgroups enforce it; elsewhere each command says it did not apply.
performance_soft_shares_note.zh: 软放置加下方填写的内存上限，每个 run 的全部命令合用；留空不限。超过上限的分配在这个 run 里失败，命令结果和终端会说撞到了上限。Windows job 和获委派的 Linux cgroup 执行它；别处每条命令都会说上限没有生效。

setup_group_hint_performance.en: Core threads and per-run resources. Changes take effect after restarting the city server.
setup_group_hint_performance.zh: 核心线程与每个 run 的资源；重启城服务后生效。
